item.title: Área de producción de oro aluvial de Colombia crece en 2025 por tercer año consecutivo: informe
item.description: La superficie con explotación de oro de aluvión en Colombia creció un 4,5% interanual en 2025 y alcanzó un récord de 118.410 hectáreas, impulsada por la expansión de la actividad en tierras de comunidades negras, reveló el viernes un informe de la Oficina de las Naciones Unidas contra la Droga y el Delito (UNODC) y del Gobierno.
item.dc:creator: Luis Jaime Acosta
item.content:encoded: La superficie con explotación de oro de aluvión en Colombia creció un 4,5% interanual en 2025 y alcanzó un récord de 118.410 hectáreas, impulsada por la expansión de la actividad en tierras de comunidades negras, reveló el viernes un informe de la Oficina de las Naciones Unidas contra la Droga y el Delito (UNODC) y del Gobierno. El alza, de 5.100 hectáreas frente a las 113.310 de 2024, se registró en zonas con fuerte presencia de grupos armados ilegales. El país sudamericano completó en 2025 su tercer año consecutivo de aumento de la superficie explotada. "El 75% es ilícita, el 21% cuenta con permisos técnicos y/o ambientales, y el 4% se encuentra en tránsito a la legalidad", indicó el informe. El reporte señaló que 15 de los 32 departamentos del país registraron evidencias de explotación de oro de aluvión (EVOA) y que el 61% del aumento se produjo en tierras de comunidades negras. Asimismo, se detectó explotación en 30 resguardos indígenas. De acuerdo con la UNODC, la mayor parte del oro en Colombia se encuentra en territorios habitados por comunidades negras, lo que explica el aumento de la explotación en esas zonas. Las comunidades negras e indígenas han sido históricamente más vulnerables al conflicto armado, a la pobreza y al aislamiento en zonas rurales debido a la escasa presencia del Estado. Casi la mitad de la explotación, 58.216 hectáreas, se encuentra en áreas donde la minería no está permitida, incluidas zonas de reserva forestal y parques nacionales naturales. El número de municipios con esta actividad y presencia de al menos un grupo armado ilegal pasó de 114 en 2024 a 118 en 2025. Además, 79 de los municipios con explotación de oro en 2025 tenían cultivos de coca, principalmente en los departamentos de Antioquia, Nariño, Cauca y Chocó. Colombia vive un conflicto armado interno de más de seis décadas, que ha dejado alrededor de 450.000 muertos y en el que guerrillas izquierdistas y bandas criminales conformadas por antiguos paramilitares de derecha se enfrentan entre sí y con las Fuerzas Armadas del Estado. La extracción ilícita de oro es la segunda fuente de financiación de los grupos armados ilegales, después del narcotráfico, según fuentes de seguridad. La ministra de Minas y Energía, María Nohemí Arboleda, dijo, durante la presentación del informe, que la explotación ilícita de oro está destruyendo las selvas y contaminando los ríos con químicos. "En casi la mitad del área con explotación de oro de aluvión hay también cultivos de coca. Es una mezcla, un negocio perfecto. Aquí no hay un debate sobre la minería: hay una confrontación entre el Estado y las economías criminales que usan el oro para financiar la violencia", afirmó Arboleda. Arboleda aseguró que los países compradores de oro deben exigir trazabilidad para comprobar la legalidad del metal y dijo que el Estado debe llegar a los territorios afectados por la minería ilícita y quedarse.

item.title: DOJ will not reopen criminal probe into Fed's Powell, spokesperson says
item.description: The US Justice Department is not reopening a criminal probe into former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell for cost overruns related to the central bank's building renovation project, a DOJ spokesperson said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department is not reopening a criminal probe into former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell for cost overruns related to the central bank's building renovation project, a DOJ spokesperson said on Friday. Attorney General Todd Blanche, in comments to Bloomberg News, which first reported the development, said he has not ruled out continuing to look into the project's oversight and potentially take action if evidence of wrongdoing came to light. The Fed's [USN:L6N45M161 TEXT:"Inspector General on Wednesday"] said it found no grounds for a criminal referral or evidence of administrative misconduct tied to the project cost overruns, but its conclusion there was lax oversight drew a fresh call from President Donald Trump for Powell's resignation. Powell has remained at the Fed as a governor since stepping down as chair in May. His successor Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said on Thursday he would hire an independent auditor to "verify accuracy and compliance" for all of the project's costs. Blanche told Bloomberg News that if this new review finds any evidence of criminal wrongdoing, the Justice Department could investigate. At his final press conference as Fed chief in April, Powell said he would not leave the Board "until this investigation is well and truly over, with transparency and finality." A Fed spokesperson had no immediate comment on Blanche's statements.

item.title: Un exdiputado de EEUU, condenado a 10 años de prisión por ejercer presión en favor de Venezuela
item.description: El legislador estadounidense David Rivera fue condenado el viernes a 10 años de prisión por hacer gestiones ilegales con funcionarios estadounidenses para que aliviaran la presión sobre el gobierno del derrocado presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: El legislador estadounidense David Rivera fue condenado el viernes a 10 años de prisión por hacer gestiones ilegales con funcionarios estadounidenses para que aliviaran la presión sobre el gobierno del derrocado presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro. Rivera, un republicano que representó al sur de Florida en la Cámara de Representantes de Estados Unidos entre 2011 y 2013, fue declarado culpable en mayo de haber ejercido presión sobre funcionarios estadounidenses en nombre de Venezuela en 2017 sin registrarse como lobista extranjero, tal y como exige la ley. La sentencia fue dictada por la jueza federal de distrito Melissa Damian en una vista celebrada en un tribunal federal de Miami. La Fiscalía de Estados Unidos en Miami había instado a Damian a imponer una "pena de prisión significativa". Rivera, de 61 años, se declaró inocente, y sus abogados alegaron que no debería cumplir pena de prisión porque había estado trabajando para ayudar a la oposición venezolana a derrocar a Maduro, y no para beneficiar a su Gobierno.

item.title: Capa da Veja dizendo que Lula apoia "excluir Nossa Senhora Aparecida" é falsa
item.description: É falso que a revista Veja tenha publicado uma capa sobre um suposto projeto do PT para destituir Nossa Senhora Aparecida do posto de padroeira do Brasil com apoio do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, como dizem publicações nas redes sociais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: É falso que a revista Veja tenha publicado uma capa sobre um suposto projeto do PT para destituir Nossa Senhora Aparecida do posto de padroeira do Brasil com apoio do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, como dizem publicações nas redes sociais. "Projeto de lei de deputado petista, com apoio de Lula, visa excluir Nossa Senhora Aparecida e favorecer umbanda", diz a manchete da suposta edição de número 2.842, datada de 26 de setembro de 2026. No entanto, a edição da Veja de data mais próxima é a de número 3.014, de 25 de setembro, que mostra na capa o presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) e o ex-dono do Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro. A editora Abril, que publica a Veja, afirmou à Reuters que a imagem é falsa e que todas as capas oficiais podem ser verificadas no site da revista. A campanha de Lula também disse que o conteúdo é falso. "O presidente Lula trata todas as religiões de forma igual e defende o exercício livre da fé", alegou em nota . Uma pesquisa no site da Câmara dos Deputados não mostra uma proposta semelhante à dos posts entre as proposições em tramitação apresentadas por petistas na Casa. O vice-presidente do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), ministro André Mendonça, determinou a retirada de quatro posts com a capa falsa do X. Segundo ele, a imagem não se apresenta como “simples opinião, crítica, sátira ou manifestação humorística” e “foi confeccionada para reproduzir a aparência de produto jornalístico real”. A capa falsa mostra uma foto da primeira-dama Janja Lula da Silva vestida de branco ao lado de estátuas de orixás. A imagem foi originalmente postada no perfil de Janja no X em fevereiro de 2021. A montagem circula dias após os rumores de que o candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) pretende destituir Nossa Senhora Aparecida do título de padroeira do Brasil caso eleito, o que ele nega. Desde então, a Reuters verificou conteúdos desinformativos ligados a questões religiosas e à campanha eleitoral. (Este texto foi corrigido em 2 de outubro de 2026 para retificar o nome do partido de Flávio Bolsonaro.) VEREDICTO Falso. É uma montagem a capa da revista Veja com uma foto de Janja e a manchete sobre uma proposta de um deputado do PT para “excluir” Nossa Senhora Aparecida em prol da umbanda. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: 米・ウクライナ復興基金、初の重要鉱物案件合意 レアアースなど鉱床開発
item.description:
Marc Jones
［ロンドン ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Marc Jones

［ロンドン　２日　ロイター］ - 米国とウクライナが共同で設立した「復興投資基金」は、重要鉱物分野で初となる案件を含む５件の新規プロジェクトで合意した。同基金の米政府高官が２日、ロイターに対し明らかにした。

復興投資基金はトランプ米大統領の働きかけを受けて２０２５年４月に両国が締結した「鉱物資源協定」の一環として設立されたもので、鉱物資源、防衛、エネルギー、インフラなど５つの戦略分野への投資に重点を置いている。復興投資基金を監督する米国際開発金融公社（ＤＦＣ）のコナー・コールマン投資責任者によると、基金が手掛ける案件の総額は約７０００万ドルに達した。

コールマン氏はロイターのインタビューに対し、投資案件はロシアによる全面侵攻を受けるウクライナに対する米国の支援を示しているとし、基金の投資余力を拡大するために新たな資金調達先を模索していると述べた。冬の到来を前にウクライナが継続的に被害にさらされていることに触れ、「現時点で投資することがウクライナ国民にとって極めて重要だ」と語った。

コールマン氏によると、初の重要鉱物案件はウクライナ最大のスーパーマーケットチェーン「ＡＴＢ」の共同所有者で富豪のゲンナジー・ブトケビッチ氏が設立したＢＧＶグループとの共同投資プラットフォームに約３０００万ドルを投じるもの。この共同投資プラットフォームはウクライナ国内の初期段階にある鉱山開発事業を対象にレアアース（希土類）、ウラン、ベリリウム、ジルコニウム鉱床の開発を進める。コールマン氏は「いずれも米国の重要鉱物リストに含まれており、米政権の優先課題とも整合的だ」と述べた。

この日に発表された他の新規案件のうち２件は、冬を前にロシアによる重要インフラ攻撃が増加する中、ウクライナの電力・暖房網の強化を目的としたもの。コールマン氏によるとこのうち１件は、ＤＦＣがウクライナ最大の民間エネルギー企業ＤＴＥＫに対し新たな蓄電システム向けとして決定した約１億ドルの融資を補完する。同蓄電システムは約６０万世帯に最大２時間のバックアップ電力を供給できるという。

復興投資基金はこのほか、損傷した電力・熱供給網の復旧を目的とする複数の「エネルギーハブ」の建設・運営を支援する熱電併給（コージェネレーション）プラットフォームにも出資する。

item.title: Nigeria says domestic gas supply surpasses 2 billion cubic feet per day, eyes further growth
item.description: Nigeria's domestic gas supply has crossed 2 billion cubic feet per day (bcf/d), as the government pushes to expand supplies to power plants and industries and reduce constraints on economic growth, the country's gas minister said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Camillus Eboh
item.content:encoded: Nigeria's domestic gas supply has crossed 2 billion cubic feet per day (bcf/d), as the government pushes to expand supplies to power plants and industries and reduce constraints on economic growth, the country's gas minister said on Friday. Gas production rose to 7.5 bcf/d from about 6.8 bcf/d in 2023, Minister of State for Petroleum Resources (Gas) Ekperikpe Ekpo said. Proven gas reserves have increased to 215.19 trillion cubic feet (tcf) from 208.83 tcf, Ekpo said. Nigeria is targeting gas production of 10 bcf/d by 2027 and 12 bcf/d by 2030 to meet growing demand from power generation, industry, fertiliser production, petrochemicals, liquefied natural gas (LNG), transportation and export markets. To support higher domestic supply, the Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben (OB3) pipeline has reached full completion and is being prepared for first gas, Ekpo said. The pipeline can transport 2 bcf/d and is expected to unlock more than 500 million standard cubic feet per day (MMscf/d) of additional gas for the domestic market. The Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano (AKK) pipeline is about 95% complete, he added. Ekpo said 671 billion naira ($434 million) deployed through the Midstream and Downstream Gas Infrastructure Fund had attracted about 1.6 trillion naira in private investment across 31 projects and 205 infrastructure assets. The projects are expected to deliver about 475 MMscf/d to the domestic market when fully operational. Nigeria is targeting about $30 billion in gas-sector investment by 2030.

item.title: Bayer to invest $2.2 billion in new US pharma site
item.description: Bayer's pharmaceuticals unit on Friday unveiled plans to invest $2.2 billion in a new manufacturing site in New Albany, Ohio, part of a push to boost the business's US revenue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bayer's pharmaceuticals unit on Friday unveiled plans to invest $2.2 billion in a new manufacturing site in New Albany, Ohio, part of a push to boost the business's US revenue. Bayer expects to create about 600 high paying jobs in New Albany, with another 1,500 jobs resulting temporarily from construction. The prescription drug unit of Germany's Bayer has increased the US share of global revenue to 35% from 20% in 2018 and it aims to double US sales by the end of the decade, said Sebastian Guth, chief operating officer for pharmaceuticals. Among the main products to underpin the expansion are Kerendia to treat chronic kidney disease, prostate cancer drug Nubeqa as well as drug candidate asundexian to prevent strokes. US prescription medicine prices are far higher than in other developed nations, and President Donald Trump has been pressuring drugmakers to lower their prices, while also demanding that other developed countries increase their prices. "It is a very deliberate decision to strengthen our presence in the United States, alongside our historically strong presence in Europe and our strong presence in Asia," said Bayer Pharma's Guth. A drug substance manufacturing site is set to become operational in 2031 with a site for finished drug product to follow in 2034.

item.title: Former US congressman sentenced to 10 years for secretly lobbying for Venezuela
item.description: Former US Congressman David Rivera was sentenced to 10 years in prison on Friday for illegally lobbying US officials to ease pressure on ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro's government.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: Former US Congressman [USN:L6N41E0TG TEXT:"David Rivera"] was sentenced to 10 years in prison on Friday for illegally lobbying US officials to ease pressure on ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro's government. Rivera, a Republican who represented southern Florida in the US House of Representatives from 2011 to 2013, was [USN:L6N40B0RT TEXT:"convicted"] at trial in May of lobbying US officials on Venezuela's behalf in 2017 without registering as a foreign lobbyist as required by the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA). The sentence was handed down by US District Judge Melissa Damian at a hearing in federal court in Miami. Prosecutors with the Miami US Attorney's office had urged Damian to impose a "significant term of incarceration." They said Rivera acted on behalf of a "hostile foreign government" and was paid $20 million by the US subsidiary of Venezuela 's state oil company. Rivera, 61, pleaded not guilty, and his lawyers said he should be spared prison time. They argued he had been working to help Venezuela's opposition remove Maduro from power, not benefit his government. Rivera was charged in 2022, during Democratic President Joe Biden's administration, and defense lawyers noted that Republican President Donald Trump has deemphasized FARA cases since taking office in January 2025.

item.title: Codirector del Banco Central de Colombia considera necesario pensar en instrumentos diferentes a tasa de interés para reducir inflación
item.description: Es necesario pensar en instrumentos diferentes a la tasa de interés para reducir la inflación, dijo el viernes el codirector del Banco Central de Colombia, César Giraldo, sin ofrecer más detalles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Es necesario pensar en instrumentos diferentes a la tasa de interés para reducir la inflación, dijo el viernes el codirector del Banco Central de Colombia, César Giraldo, sin ofrecer más detalles. Los comentarios de Giraldo se registran dos días después de el que directorio del Banco Central decidió por mayoría incrementar su tasa de interés de referencia en 25 puntos base a un 12,25%, en busca de contener las presiones inflacionarias, en una decisión que sorprendió a la mayoría del mercado que esperaba que la mantuviera estable. "La tasa de interés lleva dos años siendo altamente contraccionista en términos reales, es el país que más ha subido la tasa de interés en el mundo, 300 puntos básicos en lo que llevamos de un año y, si la inflación no ha cedido, es porque el instrumento está agotado", dijo Giraldo a Blu Radio. "Entonces, yo creo que hay que pensar en otros instrumentos", aseguró. En la reunión del miércoles, la decisión de subir la tasa referencial contó con el voto de cuatro de los siete miembros del directorio, mientras que dos se inclinaron por dejarla estable y uno por aumentarla en 50 puntos base. La inflación en Colombia alcanzó al cierre de agosto un 6,24% anual, más del doble de la meta del Banco Central de 3% y amenaza con seguir subiendo por el eventual impacto del fenómeno climático de El Niño sobre los precios.

item.title: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson (ankle) out vs. Dolphins
item.description: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson has been ruled out of Sunday's game versus the visiting Miami Dolphins due to a sprained ankle.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson has been ruled out of Sunday's game versus the visiting Miami Dolphins due to a sprained ankle. Jefferson sustained the injury on a 10-yard reception in the first quarter of Minnesota's 23-16 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers last Sunday. An MRI confirmed a sprained left ankle for Jefferson, who did not participate in practice all week. Jefferson played in all 17 regular-season games for Minnesota in 2024 and 2025. The seven-year veteran missed seven games in 2023 with a torn right hamstring. With Jefferson sidelined, Jordan Addison and tight end T.J. Hockenson likely will see an increased workload for the Vikings (3-0) in their game against the Dolphins (0-3) in Minneapolis. Jefferson, 27, has collected 13 receptions for 179 yards and two touchdowns in three games this season. The 2022 Offensive Player of the Year, Jefferson has 592 catches for 8,659 yards and 44 touchdowns in 97 career games (94 starts) since being selected by the Vikings with the 22nd overall pick of the 2020 NFL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: Autoridad ambiental de Colombia otorga licencia a proyecto Bucare, de Ecopetrol, permitiendo avance a etapa de producción
item.description: La Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales de Colombia (ANLA) informó el viernes que otorgó la licencia al Área de Desarrollo Bucare, operada por el conglomerado energético Ecopetrol en el sureste del país, con lo que el proyecto podrá avanzar hacia la etapa de producción.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales de Colombia (ANLA) informó el viernes que otorgó la licencia al Área de Desarrollo Bucare, operada por el conglomerado energético Ecopetrol en el sureste del país, con lo que el proyecto podrá avanzar hacia la etapa de producción. La licencia contempla la construcción de infraestructura para la perforación de pozos, así como plataformas, instalaciones de producción, líneas de flujo, vías de acceso y sistemas asociados a la operación, en el municipio de Acacías, ubicado en el departamento del Meta, precisó la ANLA en un comunicado. El proyecto abarcará un área de 10.412 hectáreas e incluirá infraestructura para la producción de hidrocarburos y para la generación de energía mediante un parque fotovoltaico de hasta 42 megavatios (MW). "Durante la ejecución del proyecto, la ANLA mantendrá el seguimiento a las obligaciones establecidas en la licencia ambiental, verificando la implementación efectiva de las medidas de manejo, prevención, mitigación y compensación aprobadas", indicó la ANLA. El plan prevé la construcción y operación de hasta 16 locaciones de producción, una Central de Facilidades de Producción (CPF) de hasta 42 hectáreas y tres facilidades satélites de hasta cinco hectáreas cada una. Además, comprende hasta 33 kilómetros de nuevas vías de acceso, 132 kilómetros de líneas de flujo y 28 kilómetros de líneas de transmisión eléctrica de 34,5 y 115 kilovoltios (kV). El Área de Desarrollo Bucare pertenece al bloque CPO-9, operado actualmente por Ecopetrol que alcanzó una producción promedio de 26.300 barriles por día al cierre del segundo trimestre de 2026.

item.title: Diesel tem leve alta na semana no Brasil e renova máxima desde abril, mostra ANP
item.description: O preço médio do diesel S-10 nos postos do Brasil encerrou a semana com leve alta de 0,3%, a R$7,35 por litro, renovando máxima desde abril, apontou pesquisa da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O preço médio do diesel S-10 nos postos do Brasil encerrou a semana com leve alta de 0,3%, a R$7,35 por litro, renovando máxima desde abril, apontou pesquisa da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) nesta sexta-feira. A média atual, a maior desde os R$7,38 por litro entre 19 e 25 de abril, ocorre após nova escalada dos preços do petróleo no mercado internacional em setembro, quando o Brent voltou a superar US$100 o barril diante de tensões geopolíticas e ataques no Oriente Médio relacionados ao Irã. O combustível mais consumido do Brasil acumulou um avanço de 6,8% desde o fim de agosto, com impacto da alta das cotações do mercado global para o Brasil. Contudo, uma defasagem recorde registrada entre o preço da Petrobras e as cotações internacionais levantou preocupações sobre o adiamento de compras externas por importadores privados. Cerca de 30% do consumo nacional é atendido por importações. Na semana passada, entretanto, o secretário de Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis do Ministério de Minas e Energia, Renato Dutra, afirmou que o abastecimento de diesel S-10 para outubro estava garantido no Brasil. A pesquisa da ANP também indicou que o etanol hidratado teve leve alta de 0,7% nesta semana ante a semana anterior, a R$4,13 por litro, enquanto a gasolina ficou estável em R$6,55 por litro.

item.title: Entrega de materiais de campanha por carteiros não é irregular
item.description: Posts nas redes sociais sugerem ser irregular que carteiros distribuam materiais de campanha eleitoral, mas a entrega é legal e permitida por meio do serviço de mala direta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Posts nas redes sociais sugerem ser irregular que carteiros distribuam materiais de campanha eleitoral, mas a entrega é legal e permitida por meio do serviço de mala direta. O conteúdo reproduz um vídeo registrado em Santa Catarina, no qual um homem pergunta a uma carteira se ela está entregando panfletos do PT, enquanto ela mostra uma pilha de flyers dos candidatos ao Senado Décio Lima e à Câmara dos Deputados Ana Paula Lima, ambos do PT catarinense. "Todo mundo dos Correios é obrigado a entregar. Obrigatório", ela responde. "Com o nosso dinheiro", acrescenta o autor da filmagem. "Correio entregando propaganda eleitoral do PT: pode?", diz a legenda das publicações , que circulam no Facebook e no Instagram. A Reuters encontrou o vídeo publicado nesta quarta-feira no Instagram por um repórter de Santa Catarina, que disse ter recebido a filmagem de um seguidor "indignado". "A dúvida era: isso é permitido? Fui pesquisar e a resposta é sim", escreveu. Não há na postagem informações sobre a cidade ou a data do episódio. A Reuters não conseguiu contato com o repórter até a publicação deste texto. Na tarde desta sexta-feira, o post estava indisponível. Nas imagens, é possível identificar que os panfletos têm a etiqueta de Mala Direta dos Correios . Trata-se de um serviço para envio em massa de materiais impressos com fins promocionais, informativos ou eleitorais. Os Correios enviaram uma nota à Reuters informando que o "serviço de Mala Direta pode ser contratado por quaisquer candidatos e partidos políticos". "Os Correios esclarecem que a entrega de material de campanha eleitoral por seus carteiros ocorre de forma regular e em conformidade com a legislação brasileira", disseram. Em postagem no Instagram , os Correios afirmaram ainda que "o carteiro atua no cumprimento de suas obrigações profissionais, o que não pode ser caracterizado como apoio político ou uso irregular da estatal". A lei de 1978 que regulamentou os serviços postais no país incluiu a "exploração de publicidade comercial em objetos correspondência" entre as atividades dos Correios. Já o Código Eleitoral assegura aos partidos políticos "a prioridade postal durante os 60 dias anteriores à realização das eleições, para remessa de material de propaganda de seus candidatos registrados" e multa para o funcionário em caso de descumprimento -- o benefício foi posteriormente estendido às federações partidárias e coligações. Uma resolução do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) que definiu o calendário eleitoral deste ano estabeleceu a prioridade a partir de 5 de agosto de 2026 -- o primeiro turno está marcado para 4 de outubro. O TSE também publicou uma resolução em 2019 dizendo ser crime "não assegurar à funcionária ou ao funcionário postal a prioridade prevista" no Código Eleitoral. Além disso, a Lei das Eleições e outra resolução de 2019 consideram correspondência e despesas postais como gastos eleitorais que devem respeitar os registros e limites previstos na legislação. Nas despesas eleitorais de Décio Lima declaradas ao TSE, há o valor de R$88.074 pagos aos Correios por correspondências e despesas postais . Não há gastos semelhantes até o momento na declaração de Ana Paula Lima . VEREDICTO Sem contexto. A entrega de materiais de campanha eleitoral por funcionários dos Correios é permitida por lei. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: What do we know about flydubai flight 1073?
item.description: Here is what we know, and don't know, about the reported attempt by the copilot of flydubai flight 1073 to crash the plane on September 30 before it landed safely in Saudi Arabia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Here is what we know, and don't know, about the reported attempt by the copilot of flydubai flight 1073 to crash the plane on September 30 before it landed safely in Saudi Arabia. WHAT HAPPENED TO THE PLANE? The flight, carrying more than 170 mostly Israeli passengers and crew, departed Dubai at 0305 GMT, according to flight data reviewed by Reuters. At 0521 GMT in Saudi airspace it made a sudden, sharp turn and plunged towards the ground twice, before stabilising. The plane fell more than 16,000 feet in just over 30 seconds during its most dramatic dive. It then put out distress signals indicating an emergency and unlawful interference. It changed course over Jordanian airspace and diverted to land in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. At one point the transponder was turned off for nearly half an hour, according to an Israeli official. WHAT HAPPENED IN THE COCKPIT? The copilot attacked and wounded the captain during the flight, the captain, Israeli and Saudi officials say. During one of the plane's plunges, [USN:L1N45O05O TEXT:"the wounded captain"] who was lying on the floor managed to open the door, he said, allowing passengers to enter the cockpit and overpower the copilot. Israeli officials cite witnesses saying that the copilot was "bashing" the control panel, without elaborating. They say the copilot appeared to be trying to crash the plane. [USN:L8N45N0K6 TEXT:"One of the passengers"] managed to steady the plane after the copilot was subdued, which he knew how to do after watching an air-crash TV show, according to his own account. A second pair of off-duty pilots on board then took the controls and landed, according to witnesses and Israeli officials. Both the copilot and the captain suffered injuries, Saudi officials said. Videos from inside the cabin verified by Reuters show a wounded captain and copilot and blood apparently smeared on walls, and the copilot restrained by the passengers. WHAT ISN'T CLEAR? We don't know the exact timings of events on board, how the copilot overpowered the captain or what weapon he used. One passenger is heard in a video asking about a knife, and another talking about a stabbing. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has raised the possibility that a crash axe kept on board was used. HOW CLOSE DID THE PLANE COME TO CRASHING? At its steepest point, the plane was losing altitude at about 544 feet (166 metres) per second. Similar trajectories have resulted in several major crashes. WHAT ROLE DID PASSENGERS PLAY? One woman noticed a commotion in the cockpit when the captain opened the door and alerted the rest of the plane. At least four [USN:L6N45M12C TEXT:"passengers rushed towards the cockpit"], attacking and restraining the copilot. The passenger who then steadied the plane before the off-duty pilots could take over said he first pulled the copilot away from the controls with the help of the other passengers. Two other passengers attacked the copilot and tied him up using earphone cables, one of them said. A doctor on board treated the wounded captain. WHY WERE THERE OTHER TRAINED PILOTS ON THE FLIGHT? The two off-duty flydubai pilots were likely on board as backup for tired crew, a pilot interviewed by Reuters said. Middle East flights are often having to reroute because of the ongoing US-Israeli war with Iran, the pilot said. [USN:L4N45N0NH TEXT:"Flydubai"] said on Friday a full investigation was underway. WHAT DO WE KNOW ABOUT THE COPILOT? Israeli officials say the copilot is an Omani national and that he was trying to crash the plane. Little else is known about his motives or identity. Omani authorities have not commented and there has been no comment from him or a representative. After being treated for his injuries he was taken to Abu Dhabi, according to the Saudi interior ministry. Netanyahu [USN:L1N45N0GR TEXT:"told Fox News"] that the copilot had undergone "Islamist radical indoctrination", without providing details, and that he was suicidal. Israeli security officials have said he was likely acting alone, though investigation is ongoing. Israel's ambassador to the United Arab Emirates has said no motive has been determined. WAS IRAN OR ANOTHER COUNTRY INVOLVED? Israeli security officials say Israel had not identified any Iranian involvement so far. Iran has not commented. WHO IS HANDLING THE INVESTIGATION? The United Arab Emirates has [USN:S8N43T02X TEXT:"ordered"] an investigation. UAE judicial authorities have jurisdiction because the aircraft is registered in the UAE and flies under its flag. Netanyahu said Israel, which has a close diplomatic and security relationship with the UAE, will be "possibly participating" in the investigation. Saudi Arabia said it had conducted the preliminary investigation with security teams from the UAE. HOW WAS THIS ALLOWED TO HAPPEN? Pilots undergo background checks and regular psychological assessments, part of stringent measures in place since the 9/11 attacks in the United States in 2001. Israel has strict screening for anyone travelling there. That includes not normally allowing in pilots from countries without diplomatic relationships with Israel, such as Oman. Netanyahu has said Israel will look at the "loophole" that allowed the copilot on board. Israel is set to [USN:S8N45108C TEXT:"ramp up"] security checks on pilots flying into the country, Netanyahu's office said.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（2日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
反発して取引を終えた。今週は長期金利の上昇が相場の重しとなり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（2日） 3:51 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。今週は長期金利の上昇が相場の重しとなり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで２．１８％安だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．２１％高、週間では０．２８％下落した。

米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。欧州で軽油や原油の追加放出を巡って協議されていると伝わり、エネルギー供給ひっ迫への警戒感も和らいだ。

前日に２００７年以来の高水準を付けた英１０年債利回りは上昇が一服。ＦＴＳＥ３５０種住宅建設株指数は０．０７％高と反発した。銀行株指数は０．６１％高となったものの、週間では４．６３％下落。

オンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。市場環境の悪化を要因として売上高見通しを引き下げたことが売り材料視された。同業のプラス５００は５．２％、ＣＭＣマーケッツは４．０％、それぞれ下落した。

好調な業績見通しを示した資源大手グレンコアは３．０％高。パブ経営のＪＤウェザースプーンは１２．５％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。原油高や長期金利上昇が一服したことで投資家心理が改善し、買い注文が優勢だった。米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは１．１４％安と反落した。

テクノロジー株指数は前日比２．６４％高。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への期待感から半導体関連銘柄を物色する動きが目立った。ドイツのインフィニオン・テクノロジーズは８．８％、アイクストロンは７．６％、フランスのソイテックは７．７％、いずれも上昇した。

銀行株指数は０．１４％高。週間では４．８６％安だった。売上高見通しを引き下げたオンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。自社株買い計画を発表したスイスのプライベートバンク大手ジュリアス・ベアは２．０％高。

９月のユーロ圏消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）速報値は前年同月比の伸び率が拡大し、市場予想を上回った。今後数カ月でさらに上昇すると見られている。ＬＳＥＧによると、市場では１２月に欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が追加利上げするとの見方が８割超まで強まっている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

フランス１０年債利回りが約２５年ぶりに５％近辺まで上昇する場面があった。終盤は９ｂｐ低下の４．８４４％。今週は１２ｂｐ上昇した。

今週は、財政問題の悪化とインフレ高進を巡る懸念からフランスの利回りが急上昇する一方、投資家がドイツ国債やオランダ国債などの安全資産に殺到するなど、波乱の１週間だった。２日の取引もボラティリティーの高い状況が続き、特にインフレや金利の予想に敏感な短期債で値動きが荒かった。

指標となる１０年物独連邦債の利回りは一時１３．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下した。終盤は６ｂｐ低下の３．４５６％で、週間では１７ｂｐの低下となる見通し。

これにより、仏独の利回り格差は約１４０ｂｐとなった。一時１６０ｂｐ近くに急拡大し、２０１１年末以来の高水準となった。

独２年債利回りは終盤に横ばいの３．０５％。日中は２．９４３％から３．０６３％のレンジで推移した。

一方、仏２年債利回りは約４ｂｐ上昇の３．７３％で、一時は３．８４％まで上昇した。伊２年債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．５４７％。

今週は、独２年債利回りが０．２５％ポイント近く低下した一方、仏２年債利回りは１４ｂｐ近く上昇した。

ＤＺバンクのアナリスト、レネ・アルブレヒト氏は「質への逃避」を指摘し、「安全資産への需要が高まっている」と述べた。

伊１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ低下の４．６０９％となったが、週間では６ｂｐ上昇した。

item.title: US FAA says Boeing 737 MAX software glitch poses no safety issue
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration said on Friday that a panel of experts had determined a software glitch in some Boeing 737 MAX flight computers poses no safety concern, clearing the way for approval of a larger version of the best-selling narrow-body jet.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The Federal Aviation Administration said on Friday that a panel of experts had determined a software glitch in some Boeing 737 MAX flight computers poses no safety concern, clearing the way for approval of a larger version of the best-selling narrow-body jet. The decision removes a late obstacle to certification of the MAX 10, the largest variant of the 737 MAX family, which has been delayed for years. It should also ease concerns at airlines that fly the MAX 7, which uses the same software and was certified by the FAA in August. The FAA said the determination by the Corrective Action Review Board that met in Seattle on Friday was based on the fact that "pilots retain full control of the aircraft and the indications to the flight crew are clear and unambiguous." The FAA said earlier this week it was delaying certification of the MAX 10 until it completed an analysis of the software issue, which could prevent pilots from accessing automated flight guidance during an unusual landing scenario. Boeing said it "will continue to follow the lead of the FAA as our engineers work on the next software update." Boeing added it is working directly with airlines to formalize a procedure that will allow pilots "to re-enable automated vertical navigation should this situation occur." Aviation officials now believe the MAX 10 could be certified as soon as later this month. The issue could also have affected Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) because the same software is used on the newly certified MAX 7 airplane. Other large airlines, including Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) and United Airlines (UAL.O) , that have ordered the MAX 10 could also have been impacted by a lengthy delay. Jefferies said in a research note the decision allows the MAX 10 to be certified before the end of the year and estimated Boeing has nearly 1,500 MAX 10s on order from airlines. The FAA said one software version can increase pilot workload during a go-around, when a pilot aborts a landing attempt, applies power, and climbs to make another landing attempt. An FAA official said Boeing will issue a bulletin to airlines on how to recognize and respond to the situation should it occur, and the FAA will issue a Special Airworthiness Information Bulletin to US airlines and foreign regulators to ensure they’re aware of Boeing’s bulletin. Major US airlines had opted not to use that version of the software while the analysis was underway.

item.title: Colombia reports expansion of mostly illegal alluvial gold mining
item.description: Mostly illegal alluvial gold production in Colombia expanded 4.5% by area year-on-year in 2025 to 118,410 hectares, with the increase primarily on Afro-Colombian communities' land, a report by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the government showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Luis Jaime Acosta
item.content:encoded: Mostly illegal alluvial gold production in Colombia expanded 4.5% by area year-on-year in 2025 to 118,410 hectares, with the increase primarily on Afro-Colombian communities' land, a report by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the government showed on Friday. The increase of 5,100 hectares compared to 2024 marked the third consecutive year of growth, the UNODC told Reuters. "Seventy-five percent (of alluvial gold production) is illegal, 21% has technical and/or environmental permits, and 4% is in the process of becoming legal," the report said. Alluvial gold is found in river and stream beds and is typically extracted with gravity-based separation methods such as panning, sluicing and mechanized dredging and washing. Because the techniques require relatively little equipment and investment, alluvial deposits often attract small-scale illegal or informal miners. Nearly half of Colombia's 32 departments showed evidence of alluvial gold exploitation last year, with 61% of the increase on Afro-Colombian lands. Alluvial gold production was also detected in 30 Indigenous reserves, the report said. Indigenous and Black Colombians have historically been more likely to be victims of the country's six-decade-long conflict, suffer poverty and live in more isolated areas. Almost half of the areas where the production took place are zones where mining is not permitted, including forest reserves and national parks. According to security sources, illegal gold mining is the second-largest source of financing for illegal armed groups after drug trafficking. Illegal gold mining is destroying forests and polluting rivers with chemicals, Mines and Energy Minister Maria Nohemi Arboleda said during the presentation of the report. Seventy-nine municipalities with alluvial gold mining in 2025 also had coca cultivation. "Nearly half of the area with alluvial gold mining also has coca crops. It's a mix, a perfect business. This is not a debate about mining. It is a confrontation between the state and criminal economies that use gold to finance violence," Arboleda said. Arboleda said countries that buy gold should require traceability systems to verify the metal is legally sourced.

item.title: Djokovic says season has been 'a big, big struggle' after latest medical timeout
item.description: Novak Djokovic said this year has been a massive struggle, but insisted it was not due to stamina issues and was instead linked to an undisclosed health problem, after requiring another medical timeout at the China Open on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Novak Djokovic said this year has been a massive struggle, but insisted it was not due to stamina issues and was instead linked to an undisclosed health problem, after requiring another medical timeout at the China Open on Friday. The 24-time Grand Slam champion battled back from a set down to beat local hope and world number 104 Bu Yunchaokete 4-6 7-6(2) 6-2 in the last 16 in Beijing, extending his perfect record at the tournament to 31-0. Djokovic, who returned to the ATP 500 event after an 11-year absence as he seeks to regain momentum following his exit from the top 10, is aiming for a strong finish to a season that included a shock first-round loss at the U.S. Open, his earliest Grand Slam defeat since the 2006 Australian Open. The 39-year-old Serb vomited midway through the U.S. Open match and was troubled by back and shoulder issues that affected his serve late on. He had also required a medical timeout during his opening-round victory over Portugal's Nuno Borges in Beijing. "I don't want to go into details because then it's going to sound like I'm whining about something or looking for excuses," Djokovic told a news conference. "Truth is that this year has been a big, big struggle for me with few particular issues that I've been having. I've been just trying to find different ways to be at least giving myself a decent condition physically and health-wise to be on the court and compete with the player across the net. "Most of the matches and tournaments this year that I've played have been a real, real struggle for me physically. That's nothing to do with stamina. People mix it up. It's not stamina. It's something else. More related to health." Djokovic did not elaborate on the problem but said he and his team were still trying to get to the root of it. "Actually surprisingly something I haven't experienced this year so far, that in the third set I kind of broke through. I felt better. Towards the end of the second and all third set, I felt fresher than I have in the beginning of the match...," he added. "It's not fun when you're feeling like that on the court because then I'm investing my emotional, mental energy, and physical of course, more on the issues that I'm having rather than thinking about the game and how I can beat my opponent." Djokovic has won a record six China Open titles, most recently in 2015 before making his return to the tournament this season.

item.title: Owners of Brazil's Braskem finalizing counter proposal to $3 billion capital demand
item.description: Controlling shareholders of Brazil's Braskem are finalizing a counter proposal for the company's creditors after balking at lenders' demands to inject $3 billion into the petrochemical producer, two people familiar with the matter told Reuters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Luciana Magalhaes, Rodrigo Viga Gaier
item.content:encoded: Controlling shareholders of Brazil's Braskem (BRKM3.SA) are finalizing a counter proposal for the company's creditors after balking at lenders' demands to inject $3 billion into the petrochemical producer, two people familiar with the matter told Reuters on Friday. "It would be too large an injection of funds, it is far more than the company's current valuation," one source said, adding that fully meeting the request in the short time would be impossible. Negotiations continue and that a counteroffer will likely be submitted within days, the source said. Braskem's restructuring should rely more on operational improvements than on fresh equity, a second person said, adding that while new funding has not been ruled out entirely, any decision would depend on broader negotiations and potential adjustments. In September, creditors demanded a $3 billion capital injection from Braskem's controlling shareholders, state-run oil firm Petrobras (PETR3.SA) and private equity firm IG4 Capital, after the company issued a $10.9 billion out-of-court restructuring filing on August 24. Braskem has until late November to come up with a final plan with support of more than half of its creditors to avoid filing for bankruptcy. IG4 declined to comment. Petrobras and Braskem declined to comment. Earlier this month, Petrobras Chief Executive Officer Magda Chambriard told journalists in Rio de Janeiro that the company is unwilling to increase its stake in Braskem, signaling it will not inject further capital unless matched by other investors. Braskem is currently worth some 3.25 billion reais ($621.8 million), after the value of its shares fell by half in 2026. Creditors consider fresh cash essential and expect shareholders to bear their share of the burden, a third source said, signaling tense negotiations ahead. Braskem and its creditors are already at odds over fund transfers to the company's Mexican unit, Braskem Idesa, as part of a $415 million financing package and a $71 million capital injection linked to the unit's Chapter 11 filing, which also started in August. In late September, a Brazilian court blocked Braskem from transferring more funds to the unit, which is a joint venture with Mexico's Grupo Idesa [RIC:RIC:GSDC.UL]. Braskem appealed the ruling, but the matter is still pending. If overturned, resuming transfers would allow Braskem Idesa to exit Chapter 11 by November or before, a fourth source told Reuters.

item.title: Polícia britânica acusa homem de planejar atos terroristas contra Nigel Farage, do Reform UK
item.description: A polícia britânica informou nesta sexta-feira que indiciou um homem de 28 anos por conduta relacionada à preparação de atos de terrorismo, inclusive contra o líder do Reform UK, Nigel Farage.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A polícia britânica informou nesta sexta-feira que indiciou um homem de 28 anos por conduta relacionada à preparação de atos de terrorismo, inclusive contra o líder do Reform UK, Nigel Farage. “Após analisar cuidadosamente as provas, tomamos a decisão de processar Joshua Kerry por conduta relacionada à preparação de atos terroristas”, disse Frank Ferguson, promotor-chefe da Procuradoria da Coroa. “Nossos promotores trabalharam em estreita colaboração com a polícia para comprovar que há provas suficientes para levar este caso a tribunal, e continuaremos trabalhando com eles à medida que a investigação avançar.”

item.title: Mexico needs more effort to lower debt, IMF says
item.description: The International Monetary Fund said on Friday that greater efforts are needed to put Mexico's debt on a declining trajectory, even as fiscal consolidation continues in 2026, following an Article IV consultation mission to Mexico City in September.
item.dc:creator: Diego Oré, Raul Cortes
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund said on Friday that greater efforts are needed to put Mexico's debt on a declining trajectory, even as fiscal consolidation continues in 2026, following an Article IV consultation mission to Mexico City in September. The fund projected Mexico's economy will grow 1.5% in 2026 and 1.8% in 2027, though growth remains constrained mainly by external uncertainty, and called for monetary policy to maintain a moderately tight stance to lock in disinflation. Revenue mobilization, better spending prioritization and greater private sector involvement are needed to protect growth-enhancing investment, the IMF said. Headline inflation is near the central bank's target, though core price pressures and inflation expectations remain elevated, the IMF said. The IMF warned that geopolitical tensions and the effects of El Niño could add pressure to prices and delay a durable return to Banxico's 3% inflation target until early 2028. Banxico held its benchmark interest rate at 6.50% in September and expects inflation to return to its 3% target in the fourth quarter of 2027, though risks remain tilted to the upside. FISCAL POLICY The IMF said Mexico's draft 2027 budget entails a more gradual fiscal consolidation than previously announced and an upward debt trajectory in coming years. Mexico's financial system is sound, but improvements to anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing frameworks and deeper financial intermediation are needed, the fund added. According to the IMF, raising potential growth in Mexico requires closing infrastructure gaps, reducing regulatory burdens and strengthening trade integration, according to the IMF. Improving security, combating corruption and lowering informality were also cited as necessary to lift growth potential. Mexico's 2027 budget projects public debt rising to 55.0% of GDP from an estimated 54.0% at the end of 2026, even as the government continues its fiscal consolidation efforts.

item.title: Man accused of ex-minister murder charged with preparing terrorist acts against Reform UK's Nigel Farage
item.description: British police said on Friday that a man accused of murdering former minister Ann Widdecombe had now also been charged with preparing acts of terrorism, including against Nigel Farage, the leader of the populist Reform UK party.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: British police said on Friday that a man [USN:L8N43N1B1 TEXT:"accused of murdering"] former minister Ann Widdecombe had now also been charged with preparing acts of terrorism, including against Nigel Farage, the leader of the populist Reform UK party. Police and prosecutors said Joshua Kerry, 28, had been charged with engaging in conduct in preparation of terrorist acts between May 2024 and July this year, saying that these related in part to Farage. They did not provide further details. Kerry, from Rotherham in northern England, is due to appear at London's Westminster Magistrates' Court on Wednesday. "We have been running a hugely intensive and complex investigation for some time," Senior National Coordinator for Counter Terrorism Policing Vicki Evans said in a statement. "The charge announced today is a result of the tireless work of investigators across the counter terrorism policing network." FORMER MINISTER 'MURDERED AT HOME' Kerry is already facing accusations of murdering Widdecombe, 78, a prominent figure in Reform UK, who was found dead at her home in rural southwest England on July 9 after being attacked the day before. The killing of Widdecombe, who prosecutors said was struck 21 times with a hammer, shocked British politics, raising further concerns about politicians' security, with two serving British members of parliament having been killed since 2016. "Terrifying. Widdecombe alleged murderer charged with acts of terrorism against Nigel Farage over 2 years," Reform lawmaker Richard Tice wrote on X. "This is why he needs money for security." [USN:L4N4391CE TEXT:"Farage, 62,"] often credited with forcing the 2016 referendum on whether Britain should stay in the European Union, has been one of the most influential, but also one of the most divisive, figures in British politics for more than a decade. When campaigning for parliament in 2024, Farage had a [USN:S8N3G40EP TEXT:"milkshake"] thrown at him by a woman and on another occasion [USN:L8N3I90R0 TEXT:"objects were hurled"] towards his open-top bus by a man. Reform UK was leading in the polls until recently, though a combination of allegations over party funding and Andy Burnham taking over as prime minister has seen an erosion in its support. Farage is currently facing a parliamentary investigation over whether he should have declared a £5 million ($6.75 million) gift from a billionaire cryptocurrency investor. He has since said the money was necessary to provide him with security. "This is exactly why Nigel needed £5m to protect his security for life," a Reform UK source told Reuters. British Home Secretary (interior minister) Shabana Mahmood said the latest charges were extremely concerning. "My profound sympathies are with Nigel Farage and his family," she said on X. "Let no one make any mistake: an attack on anyone in politics is an attack on us all. This case raises serious questions about the security of those in public life."

ISLAMABAD: Pakistan 's foreign minister said Iran has suggested engaging Yemen's Houthis politically after attacks by the group, an idea a committee of the Mecca defence pact will discuss at an emergency meeting in Riyadh next week. The proposal comes as Saudi Arabia, which has accused the Houthis of targeting Islam's two holiest cities, faces escalating attacks . Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan , the pact 's three members , will decide next steps at the meeting, Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar told a news conference. He said the date would be confirmed later. Dar said Iran had distanced itself from the Houthis and Iraqi militias, and that President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi both want the matter concluded. He said he had also briefed Tehran on the defence pact and how Pakistan would honour it.

"There is no written, solid offer. It is brainstorming between two foreign ministers," Dar said, describing the political approach as a suggestion made in good faith. It would be discussed as an alternative to "kinetic action". More than six countries are keen to join the pact , Dar said, without naming them or saying whether all were Muslim-majority nations. New members hip requests cannot be entertained until the pact is fully operational, which could take up to a year, he added.

Related:

Three in four families go hungry in parts of Yemen from new fighting

Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement on Aug 7, pledging to treat an armed attack on any one of them as an attack on all three. Their military chiefs met in Riyadh on Sep 25 and condemned Houthi attacks. Pakistan 's military said in a statement on Friday (Oct 2) that its top commanders strongly condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, expressing solidarity with the kingdom and commitment to the security of Islam's holy sites. Dar also said there should be no fee or charges to cross the Strait of Hormuz. The blockaded strait has become the central bargaining chip in efforts to end the nearly seven-month US-Iran conflict.

item.description: [２日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は２日、９月の雇用統計で労働市場が安定していることが示され...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ、利上げ・据え置きとも選択肢　物価対応が優先課題＝シカゴ連銀総裁 2:44 配信

８月２７日撮影　 REUTERS/Ann Saphir

[２日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は２日、９月の雇用統計で労働市場が安定していることが示されたとし、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）にとってインフレへの対応が重要な課題になっていると述べた。

グールズビー氏はＦＯＸビジネス・ネットワークの番組「ザ・ビッグ・マネー」で、ＦＲＢは今月の会合で追加利上げを決定すべきか、それとも利上げを見送るべきかとの質問に対し、利上げと据え置きのいずれについても「なお十分に検討の余地がある」とし、「インフレ率が目標とする２％に向けて再び低下していることを示す証拠がまとまるか見極めたい」と語った。

ＦＲＢは９月１５─１６日に開いたＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来３年２カ月ぶりで、決定は全会一致だった。１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで追加利上げが決定されるとの観測は後退している。

グールズビー総裁は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持っていない。

item.description: [ローマ ２日 ロイター] - イタリアのジョルジェッティ経済・財務相は２日、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ総裁の早期退任観測、明確化必要　伊に後任候補なし＝伊経済相 2:28 配信

ラガルドECB総裁。7月23日、フランクフルトで撮影。REUTERS/Heiko Becker/File Photo

[ローマ ２日 ロイター] - イタリアのジョルジェッティ経済・財務相は２日、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁が任期途中で辞任する可能性があるといううわさについて、事実関係を明確にする必要があるとの認識を示した。

ジョルジェッティ財務相は「ラガルド総裁が何を考えているのか私には分からないが、この件を明確にしておくことは重要だと考える」と述べた。

また、イタリアは現時点でＥＣＢ総裁の後任候補として推薦する人材はいないと述べた。

ラガルド総裁を巡っては、２０２７年のフランス大統領選への出馬を目指し、ＥＣＢ総裁を任期途中で辞任するとの観測が浮上していた。これに対しラガルド総裁は今週、仏大統領選への出馬は「全く良い考えではない」と述べ、仮にＥＣＢ総裁職を退任するとしても、任期満了より数カ月早い時期にとどまるとの考えを示した。

MANCHESTER, England, Oct 2 : The UK's Liberal Democrats party on Friday urged Prime Minister Andy Burnham to disclose any meetings he has held with Manchester City's owners, Abu Dhabi representatives or related entities, stepping up criticism of his comments following the landmark ruling against the club. Burnham, who had served as the mayor of Greater Manchester from May 2017 to June 2026, had earlier this week expressed concern about City's owners potentially selling the club, saying they had been "a huge partner in the building of modern Manchester" and "in turning the club into a global force". Burnham's comments drew heavy criticism from opposition politicians. "Football fans up and down the country deserve to know that the rules apply to everyone, however rich and powerful they are," Anna Sabine, the party's spokesperson for culture, media and sport, told the Prime Minister in a letter.

"When the prime minister leaps to the defence of a club's owners within hours of a verdict, people are entitled to ask what their relationship is. "Andy Burnham must come clean and publish details of every meeting and conversation he has had with City Football Group, Abu Dhabi United Group or UAE government representatives, going back to his time as Mayor - and that includes any hospitality freebies received." Manchester City have filed an appeal against an independent commission ruling that found the club guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, seeking to overturn the verdict and avoid potentially severe sanctions. The league said on Tuesday that City had used "sham" commercial contracts as part of schemes to inflate revenue and understate costs by more than £900 million ($1.19 billion) over nearly a decade. The letter follows Thursday's statement from a Number 10 spokesperson that City should face the "appropriate consequences" if wrongdoing is established. Shadow Sports Minister Louie French said the government must "keep politics out of football" and ensure the independent commission is free of "outside influence."  City have denied any wrongdoing.

Oct 2 : England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been charged with breaching the England and Wales Cricket Board's (ECB) professional conduct regulations following an incident outside a nightclub in Derby, the Cricket Regulator said on Friday. Carse, 31, is alleged to have breached Regulation 3.2, which states that no participant may behave in a manner that brings the ECB, the game of cricket or any cricketer into disrepute. "The matter will now be referred to the independent Cricket Discipline Panel for adjudication," the Cricket Regulator said in a statement. "As the process is ongoing, no further comment will be made."

Carse was dropped from England's test squad during the series against Pakistan in August after videos circulated on social media appearing to show the seamer in handcuffs while speaking with police officers outside a Derby nightclub. He was briefly arrested and subsequently de-arrested, with no charges brought against him. The ECB said at the time that the Cricket Regulator would investigate whether Carse had breached its code of conduct. Carse has not featured for England since the incident, although he has continued to play county cricket for Durham. He was also left out of England's squad for the one-day tri-series in Pakistan later this month. "We are aware of the Cricket Regulator's decision to charge Brydon Carse," an ECB spokesperson said. "Brydon now has the opportunity to respond through the established process. As we do not wish to prejudge the outcome, it would not be appropriate for us to comment further." The latest development comes amid a period of heightened scrutiny around discipline and conduct in English cricket. This summer, former captain Ben Stokes and fast bowler Gus Atkinson were dropped for the second test against New Zealand after breaching a team curfew, while Harry Brook was fined 30,000 pounds ($39,675) last winter following an altercation with a bouncer in Wellington. Media reports also highlighted player drinking during a mid-Ashes break in Noosa. Former test captain Stokes later retired from international cricket, while head coach Brendon McCullum was dismissed as test coach after a turbulent period for the team. Carse has also previously faced disciplinary issues. In 2024, the South African-born seamer received a three-month suspension for historic betting offences. ($1 = 0.7561 pounds)
