item.title: Euroleague to debate NBA tie-up as Europe basketball future hangs in balance
item.description: The clock is ticking for the NBA and Euroleague to find common ground in time for a joint launch next year, as the North American titan eyes an expansion across the Atlantic that could alter the ecosystem of European basketball.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow, Amy Tennery, Frank Pingue
item.content:encoded: The clock is ticking for the NBA and Euroleague to find common ground in time for a joint launch next year, as the North American titan eyes an expansion across the Atlantic that could alter the ecosystem of European basketball. Euroleague shareholders are due to meet on Monday in Italy to discuss a proposal that would see it join forces with the National Basketball Association, rather than compete against one another. The upcoming discussions at Lake Como represent a fork in the road for the future of European basketball: Should a merger be agreed, it would represent a significant shift in governance, structure and the financing of Europe’s continental competition. If no agreement is found, NBA Europe and the Euroleague are set to enter into a rivalry, with the latter intending to alter the existing format, expanding the competition in the process. "This is a unique opportunity historically to bring all sides together - including FIBA - and reshape the European basketball ecosystem," Lega Basket Serie A President Maurizio Gherardini told Reuters. Euroleague is crafting its own expansion project while the NBA is barrelling forward with an expected 16-team league that would include 10-12 permanent franchises and four to six spots available through qualification. The NBA has made clear it intends to launch in 2027 whether or not an agreement is reached, leaving Euroleague clubs to decide whether they are better served joining forces with the new competition or trying to withstand it. A Euroleague spokesperson said conversations with the NBA were focused on a path forward that would see the two work together. NBA READY TO MOVE FORWARD A picture of what an NBA Europe would look like is beginning to emerge. Teams would come from three pathways, including existing clubs, franchises launched by outside investors and clubs founded by existing European soccer teams. "QSI has been approached … maybe two years ago," Paris St Germain owner Qatar Sports Investments told Reuters. "We’ve been actively involved in discussions for at least a year." Real Madrid, AC Milan and Barcelona, which have also been named. as potential affiliate clubs for NBA Europe teams, did not respond to a request for comment. The NBA's managing director for Europe and the Middle East, George Aivazoglou, is due to provide a public update on talks at a summit in London on Thursday. "All bidders, including football clubs, are not rushing into it since the Euroleague’s position is not yet clear," a source familiar with the discussions told Reuters. 'INJECTION OF MONEY' The NBA previously [USN:L1N3QQ016 TEXT:"told Reuters"] it believes the sport is lagging behind its potential across the continent. NBA Europe would also align domestic league and national team schedules, allowing players to represent club and country year-round and resolve scheduling conflicts that exist. Euroleague enjoys robust attendance and fanbases but lacks permanent teams in some major markets, with criticism over stadium infrastructure a longstanding sticking point. "They're gonna bring an injection of money, of professionalism in the way they treat their players," player-turned-agent Pete Mickeal told Reuters. Mickeal played several years in the EuroLeague and won the championship in 2010. "Every single player that ever played in Europe has had a money issue. These are the things that I think, when the NBA comes in, that's gonna change." Mickeal also pointed to the multi-billion-dollar league's superior marketing and resources to bring teams to major-market cities. "They have everything at their fingertips," said Mickeal, who heads his Mickeal Sports Group agency. "Everything is right there for them to go get it." NBA Europe has identified potential locations for 12 anchor teams, targeting London, Paris, Rome, Milan, Berlin, Munich, Istanbul, Madrid, Athens, Barcelona, Manchester, and Lyon, The Athletic said. Were the Euroleague to execute their expansion plan, it would see the current 20-team competition gain four teams next season. A maximum of eight 'long-term' franchises would join the existing 13, the rest filled out by temporary members. The Euroleague told Reuters that 14 bids had been received for those eight spots amounting to more than €800 million ($901.36 million) in franchise fees. Under the NBA Europe proposal, not all of the 13 permanent Euroleague teams would be guaranteed a spot. The NBA says it will award franchises and set entry fees on a case-by-case basis, but media reports said they had received several bids in the $500 million to $1 billion range. ($1 = 0.8875 euros)

item.title: US senators expect vote after midterms on Trump's nuclear power pact with Saudi Arabia
item.description: US senators who have proliferation concerns about President Donald Trump's proposed nuclear power pact with Saudi Arabia said on Friday they have secured a vote on the agreement and they expect it before December 13.
item.dc:creator: Timothy Gardner
item.content:encoded: US senators who have proliferation concerns about President Donald Trump's proposed nuclear power pact with Saudi Arabia said on Friday they have secured a vote on the agreement and they expect it before December 13. Trump submitted [USN:L1N44M100 TEXT:"the proposal"] known as a 123 Agreement to Congress in late August. Senators have a 90-day window from its printing in the Senate record on September 14 to review the pact and potentially seek to pass a resolution of disapproval. "The Senate will now have a chance to fulfill its statutory responsibility to study and weigh in on the impact this agreement could have in driving a nuclear arms race in the Middle East and potentially undermining nuclear nonproliferation efforts around the world," Senator Jeff Merkley, a Democrat, said in a release reported first by Reuters. Merkley said he worked with Republicans on getting the vote with fellow Democratic Senators Tim Kaine, Ed Markey, Chris Coons and Chris Van Hollen. Some Democratic lawmakers and nonproliferation advocates have criticized the nuclear pact for not barring Saudi Arabia from enriching uranium or reprocessing nuclear waste, two potential pathways for making a nuclear weapon. The United Arab Emirates agreed to such measures, known as the gold standard, in its 2009 civil nuclear deal with Washington. Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has said he does not want to pursue nuclear weapons but if Iran gets them Saudi Arabia will develop them. The Trump administration says the deal has nonproliferation measures required by law. The nuclear agreement has also raised questions whether Saudi Arabia would get the deal without normalizing relations with Israel. Trump has said it will only go into effect if Riyadh does so, but congressional aides have said there is nothing in the pact addressing that issue. Democratic and Republican US senators [USN:L1N4580MN TEXT:"asked Trump's administration"] last month to declassify and release all information about the agreement, including two classified "side letters" reached with Riyadh. The senators said then that the government has reached dozens of 123 nuclear agreements with other countries without withholding such information.

item.title: US liquor distributor Southern Glazer's agrees to pricing restrictions in FTC settlement
item.description: Southern Glazer's, the largest US liquor distributor, agreed on Friday to a US Federal Trade Commission settlement under which the supplier of brands such as Bacardi and Smirnoff won't charge small retailers significantly more than nearby chain stores.
item.dc:creator: Jody Godoy
item.content:encoded: Southern Glazer's, the largest US liquor distributor, agreed on Friday to a US Federal Trade Commission settlement under which the supplier of brands such as Bacardi and Smirnoff won't charge small retailers significantly more than nearby chain stores. The FTC has ramped up its focus on affordability issues this year as the midterm elections approach. The agency is considering a new rule to bar misleading grocery and food delivery fees and [USN:L4N45H0T0 TEXT:"probing personalized pricing"] practices. The Southern Glazer's settlement is aimed at leveling the playing field between independent stores and bigger chains such as Walmart (WMT.O) , Costco (COST.O) and Kroger (KR.N) , which the FTC alleged had received better prices. "Small businesses are an invaluable part of the American economy and way of life," FTC Bureau of Competition Director Daniel Guarnera said. For six years, Southern Glazer's will be subject to penalties if it gives its biggest customers in 26 states significantly better prices than independent stores nearby, the FTC said. A monitor will oversee the settlement. Southern Glazer’s Chief Legal Officer Alan Greenspan said the company did not violate the law and has not admitted wrongdoing in the settlement. "The proposed order does not outright prohibit Southern Glazer’s from engaging in any particular business activity, and we do not anticipate material changes to our business or pricing practices," Greenspan said. The FTC sued Southern Glazer's in 2024, accusing it of violating the Robinson-Patman Act, a law aimed at protecting small retailers from bigger competitors. The case marked the [USN:L1N3ND0UA TEXT:"first time in decades"] the FTC had enforced the RPA, which was a priority for former FTC Chair Lina Khan. Current FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson had voted against suing Southern Glazer's, saying that while the agency should enforce the RPA, the case was weak. Passed in 1936 during the Great Depression, the Robinson-Patman Act prohibits a seller from offering different prices for the same goods to different buyers. The law has a few exceptions, such as when shipping costs are higher for one customer than another.

item.title: ＥＣＢ副総裁、銀行規制の簡素化提案 資本要件緩和には否定的
item.description: [フランクフルト ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[フランクフルト　２日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のブイチッチ副総裁は２日、欧州の銀行業界から見直しを求める声が出ている銀行規制について「堅固さを確保するために必ずしも複雑なルールが必要だとは思わない」と述べ、簡素化する構えを示した。一方、「現在の資本要件の水準は、欧州の銀行にとって競争上不利に働いていない」とし、要件緩和には否定的な見解を示した。

簡素化の具体策として、資本算定に関する「キャピタル・スタック（資本積み上げ）」と呼ばれるさまざまな要件を「解除可能なバッファー」と「解除不可能なバッファー」の２つに整理する考えを示した。中小銀行についてはコスト負担を軽減するため、より簡素な規制の枠組みを設けるべきだと主張した。

欧州の銀行の経営状況については、健全性を保っており、欧州にとっての強みになっていると述べ、「堅固な金融システムこそが、持続可能な経済成長のための前提条件となる」との見解を示した。

このほか、銀行の破綻処理の枠組みを簡素化することも提案した。

item.title: Americas diplomats back joint call for Nicaragua to restore civil liberties
item.description: The Organization of American States on Friday approved a resolution that calls on Nicaraguan authorities to free political prisoners and restore civil liberties, carving a path for potential coordinated action.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Morland, Gabriela Selser
item.content:encoded: The Organization of American States on Friday approved a resolution that calls on Nicaraguan authorities to free political prisoners and restore civil liberties, carving a path for potential coordinated action. The Washington-based organization will create a task force to engage with Nicaraguan authorities and exiles to communicate its demands, including establishing conditions for fair elections, freeing political prisoners and disclosing the whereabouts of people who have been forcibly disappeared. It will then come back with recommendations for concrete actions. The government of Nicaraguan co-Presidents Daniel Ortega and his wife, Rosario Murillo, has [USN:L6N45D0OQ TEXT:"heavily restricted"] civil liberties since a wave of protests in 2018. Last month, it [USN:S0N3XE07V TEXT:"banned the opposition"] from participating in future elections. OAS Secretary-General Albert Ramdin told Reuters he hoped the meeting would ultimately lead to more than verbal condemnation over human rights abuses. "That has been said many times already. It is good to say this again collectively, but that cannot be the only outcome," Ramdin said. "It must also be, what do we do next?" Nicaragua left the OAS in 2023, saying the diplomatic organization had become a tool for US interventionism. The group cannot itself impose sanctions though it can act as a forum for its members to coordinate joint measures. Murillo did not immediately respond to a request for comment. REGIONAL RIFT The resolution was approved at the OAS' first meeting of foreign ministers in seven years, which was largely attended by deputies or ambassadors delegated by the organization's 32 foreign ministries. Washington, which proposed the meeting, sent Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau. Landau told the meeting Managua had rejected the newly appointed ambassador from the US and accused security services from an unnamed "non-hemispheric" nation of training Nicaraguan police and sharing intelligence. Nicaragua has security cooperation agreements with Russia and China. "The democratic crisis in Nicaragua isn't solely an internal matter," Landau said. "These actors aren't only propping up a dictatorship; they're using Nicaragua as a springboard into our region, threatening the peace and security of Central America and our hemisphere." Earlier drafts of the resolution exposed a rift. The US and aligned right-leaning governments pushed for stronger language and alleged a foreign security presence in Nicaragua, while other Latin American countries, including Brazil and Mexico, said Nicaragua should not be considered a regional threat. The Dominican Republic, one of nearly 20 countries to join a US-led coalition called Shield of the Americas, announced at the meeting it would withdraw its embassy from Nicaragua.

item.title: Países do G7 concordam em liberar reservas de diesel e petróleo após pressão dos EUA
item.description: Os países do G7 concordaram nesta sexta-feira em liberar 100 milhões de barris de diesel e petróleo bruto das reservas de emergência e se comprometeram a não impor restrições à exportação de energia, após pressão do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Kate Abnett, Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: Os países do G7 concordaram nesta sexta-feira em liberar 100 milhões de barris de diesel e petróleo bruto das reservas de emergência e se comprometeram a não impor restrições à exportação de energia, após pressão do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump. Os EUA lideraram uma campanha de pressão sobre a União Europeia para que esta reduzisse seus estoques de emergência de diesel, com o governo Trump alertando que a falta de ação poderia levar a uma proibição das exportações de diesel pelos EUA. Tal proibição poderia reduzir drasticamente o abastecimento à Europa, que tem se tornado cada vez mais dependente do diesel norte-americano, e potencialmente acarretar altos custos econômicos para o bloco. Trump busca conter a alta dos preços dos combustíveis antes das eleições de meio de mandato de novembro. A guerra no Irã provocou, em março, a maior liberação de estoques de emergência da história, totalizando 400 milhões de barris, coordenada pela Agência Internacional de Energia (IEA, na sigla em inglês). "Levando em conta os compromissos já cumpridos, implementaremos nossos compromissos com uma liberação coordenada, por meio da IEA, de 100 milhões de barris", afirmou o G7 em comunicado conjunto. O grupo informou que a medida terá início imediato e durará quatro meses, com uma liberação substancial de diesel concentrada no início, a ser realizada pelos membros e parceiros do G7 em até 20 dias. Não estava claro quanto do petróleo previsto no novo acordo viria do que restou do pacto de março. O diretor-executivo da IEA, Fatih Birol, disse esta semana que os membros haviam liberado cerca de dois terços dos 400 milhões de barris previstos no acordo. A liberação terá início imediato e durará quatro meses, com uma quantidade substancial de diesel a ser liberada em até 20 dias pelos membros e parceiros do G7, informou o comunicado. O comunicado não forneceu uma discriminação dos volumes de petróleo bruto, diesel e outros produtos a serem liberados, nem indicou quais países participariam. "Nos reuniremos no âmbito da IEA nos próximos dias para discutir a possibilidade de liberações adicionais de diesel, conforme necessário", acrescentou o comunicado. "A Europa acaba de concordar em liberar uma quantidade enorme de seu diesel, que está em estoque em grande volume. O processo terá início imediatamente", escreveu Trump em uma postagem no Truth Social nesta sexta-feira. ÍNDICES DE APROVAÇÃO EM BAIXA Trump busca reduzir os preços dos combustíveis, já que enfrenta um índice de aprovação de 32% — o mais baixo de sua carreira — em uma pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos, com os eleitores particularmente preocupados com o custo de vida. A pesquisa, realizada entre 17 e 20 de setembro, revelou que apenas 17% dos norte-americanos aprovavam a maneira como Trump tem lidado com o custo de vida. O governo tornou a redução dos preços da energia uma prioridade, na tentativa de amenizar o impacto da guerra contra o Irã e dos altos custos dos combustíveis sobre os consumidores e setores que dependem do diesel, como o transporte rodoviário e a agricultura. A Casa Branca está preparando um decreto para combater os preços recordes do diesel nos EUA, que poderá ser divulgado já na próxima semana, segundo duas pessoas a par do processo. Espera-se que o decreto inclua medidas para ampliar o uso de diesel vermelho, isento de impostos, e outras alterações tributárias para reduzir os custos com combustível, disseram as fontes. Os detalhes ainda estão sendo elaborados e podem sofrer alterações. PROIBIÇÃO DE EXPORTAÇÃO FORA DE QUESTÃO A declaração do G7 afirmou que os países-membros se absterão de impor restrições à exportação de produtos energéticos entre si, uma medida que poderia aliviar a pressão sobre o governo Trump para que imponha uma proibição à exportação de diesel dos EUA. “Trata-se de uma declaração política, e não de um compromisso específico e vinculante, com um número expressivo destacado destinado a persuadir o presidente Trump a não impor uma proibição à exportação de diesel”, afirmaram analistas da Energy Aspects em uma nota. A Europa aumentou suas importações de diesel dos EUA este ano, à medida que a guerra contra o Irã interrompeu o abastecimento proveniente dos produtores do Golfo Pérsico. Os governos da UE discutiram na sexta-feira uma proposta da França para que os países europeus liberassem 50 milhões de barris de diesel e para que os membros da IEA liberassem 50 milhões de barris de petróleo, segundo informaram à Reuters três fontes a par das discussões. A liberação de 50 milhões de barris de diesel equivaleria a aproximadamente 17% do total das reservas de emergência de diesel e gasóleo da UE, segundo dados do Eurostat, ou cerca de 3% do consumo anual do bloco. Os futuros de diesel dos EUA caíam 3,25%, para US$4,49 por galão (3,8 litros), após notícias sobre as discussões sobre a liberação de estoques. Os futuros de referência do diesel europeu caíram cerca de US$83 por tonelada, uma queda de 5,75%, segundo dados da LSEG.

item.title: Judge warns AI could stunt lawyers' training and harm their clients
item.description: A federal judge has warned that law firms' increasing use of artificial intelligence could create risks for clients and hinder the training of junior lawyers, even as he declined to sanction attorneys over AI-generated errors in a court filing.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: A federal judge has warned that law firms' increasing use of artificial intelligence could create risks for clients and hinder the training of junior lawyers, even as he declined to sanction attorneys over AI-generated errors in a court filing. Manhattan-based US District Judge Arun Subramanian said in an order this week that the episode should serve as a "wakeup call" for lawyers, cautioning that AI-generated legal work must be carefully checked for accuracy. "While clients may demand the use of AI to save money, there is a risk of adverse consequences when things go wrong," Subramanian wrote. "For this reason, it might make sense to clients to think hard before requiring counsel to use AI for tasks such as the drafting of briefs." The judge did not say the client in this case had requested its lawyers use AI. State and federal judges [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"increasingly are weighing"] whether and how to sanction lawyers over their misuse of AI as the technology becomes more widespread. In the New York case, Subramanian in an order last month questioned whether "unchecked" use of AI led to citation errors in a copyright infringement case he was overseeing. The judge this week declined to impose sanctions on the lawyers after Cynthia Arato, an attorney for defendant Foundation Media, apologized and said the errors stemmed from another lawyer at her firm who was responsible for preparing the initial draft and finalizing it before it was filed. Arato said in a declaration this week that the lawyer, who was not named in Arato's declaration, acted "contrary to the firm's policies and training" and that the failure to check AI-generated citations was "an isolated error and not any bad faith or intent to mislead or deceive the court." Foundation Media declined to comment. There was no indication in court filings that the company had directed its outside lawyers to use AI. Arato said her firm, Shapiro Arato Bach, was implementing further safeguards against AI misuse. In a filing submitted on Thursday, Arato disclosed that the firm had used AI tools created by technology company Harvey to help prepare the improperly vetted filing. Harvey declined to comment. Subramanian said in his order that the legal profession should "think about ways to ensure that junior lawyers are getting the training they need, even as reliance on these technological tools increases." He suggested that firms could require initial drafts of briefs to be prepared without AI assistance. "The use of AI may be unavoidable, but mentoring young lawyers is a joint responsibility that we all share," Subramanian wrote. Read more: [USN:L6N45L181 TEXT:"Florida lawyer denies submitting ‘AI slop’ in bid to dodge court sanctions"] [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"AI error-ridden court filings surge despite three years of sanctions"] [USN:L6N4521AB TEXT:"Lawyer cites fake witnesses in murder case and blames ChatGPT"] [USN:L6N456132 TEXT:"Lawyer for State Farm fined over AI hallucination in Los Angeles lawsuit"] [USN:L6N451168 TEXT:"Oklahoma judge used AI in ruling that contained false citations, prosecutor says"] [USN:L6N44S0X9 TEXT:"Mississippi asks appeals court to reassign judge over 'error-plagued' AI-assisted ruling"]

item.title: 世界食料価格、9月は約4年ぶり高水準 物流混乱や悪天候響く＝ＦＡＯ
item.description:
Gus Trompiz
［パリ ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gus Trompiz

［パリ　２日　ロイター］ - 国連食糧農業機関（ＦＡＯ）が２日発表した９月の世界食料価格指数は１３６．０ポイントと、２０２２年１１月以来、３年１０カ月ぶりの高水準となった。物流の混乱や悪天候が影響し、８月改定値の１３４．０ポイントから上昇した。

エルニーニョ現象が収穫量に影響するとの懸念から、国際的に取引される砂糖の価格は１年半ぶりの高値を付けているほか、ロシアとウクライナの戦闘激化に伴う黒海からの輸出停滞が響き、９月初めには小麦先物価格が約３年ぶりの高値を記録している。

ＦＡＯのチーフエコノミスト、マキシモ・トレロ氏は声明で「ホルムズ海峡や黒海での混乱が気候関連の要因と重なり、エネルギーや輸送、主要食品の価格に上昇圧力がかかっている。広範囲で根強い上昇傾向が見られる」と指摘。「特に輸入国では消費者への食品価格の転嫁が見られるだろう」と警告した。

砂糖価格指数は前月から６．１％、穀物価格は５．１％それぞれ上昇した。黒海で続く輸送の混乱に加え、米産トウモロコシの収穫見通しの引き下げが要因。植物油価格は０．９％上昇。一方、肉類価格は１．１％低下した。

ＦＡＯは別の報告書で、２６年の世界穀物生産量を２９億７９００万トンと予測。過去最高だった２５年に次ぐ水準となる見通しだ。

item.title: Massachusetts governor asks Trump administration to speed natgas pipeline review
item.description: Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey called on the Trump administration to expedite the review of a natural gas pipeline that a unit of Canadian energy firm Enbridge is developing in New England.
item.dc:creator: Scott Disavino
item.content:encoded: Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey called on the Trump administration to expedite the review of a natural gas pipeline that a unit of Canadian energy firm Enbridge (ENB.TO) is developing in New England. After opposing most new fossil fuel projects over the past decade or so, several states in the US Northeast region have become more accepting of fossil fuel projects in recent years in an effort to help reduce soaring consumer energy bills. Healey called on the Trump administration on Thursday to expedite federal review of the expansion of the Algonquin Gas Transmission pipeline, known as the Reliable Affordable Resilient Enhancement (RARE) project, that she said US President Donald Trump has previously supported. The project is expected to provide gas supply to 600,000 customers and lower gas bills by $40 million each year. The additional gas supply from the RARE project is expected to reduce reliance on higher-cost imported liquefied natural gas (LNG) from US energy firm Constellation Energy's (CEG.O) Everett LNG import terminal in Massachusetts , the governor said. "I’ve been clear that we need to bring more energy supply into Massachusetts with an all-of-the-above approach that includes solar, wind, storage, nuclear, geothermal, hydro and gas,” Healey said. Enbridge said on its website that it was targeting a 2028 in-service date for the RARE project, which will expand capacity by around 75 million cubic feet per day. Algonquin transports roughly 3.1 billion cubic feet per day (bcfd) of gas through 1,131 miles (1,820 kilometers) of pipe in New Jersey , New York and New England. One billion cubic feet of gas can supply about 5 million US homes for a day. In January, the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities (DPU) approved two 10-year agreements between units of New England energy company Eversource Energy (ES.N) and Algonquin to deliver new gas supplies to customers. The RARE project is currently undergoing federal environmental review through the US Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, the governor said.

item.title: 米沿岸警備隊、キューバへ向かう燃料輸送船を拿捕 石油禁輸措置続く中
item.description:
Katharine Jackson
[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Katharine Jackson

[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米沿岸警備隊は２日、燃料を積んでキューバに向かっていた大型貨物船を拿捕（だほ）したと発表した。トランプ米政権によるキューバへの厳しい石油禁輸措置が続く中での動きとなる。

沿岸警備隊によると、同船は９月５日、キューバとメキシコの間のカリブ海で、当局の追跡を逃れようと航行していたところを拿捕された。ニューヨーク・タイムズ紙は、同船の全長が約９１メートルであると報じた。

沿岸警備隊は声明で「同船は燃料を積載してキューバへ向かっていた。ダークフリート（闇の船団）の間で一般的な手口を用いていたとみられる」と説明した。

声明によると、沿岸警備隊の部隊が同船に乗り込み、メキシコへ護送した。メキシコ海軍の検査チームは「同船のバラストタンク内に大量の燃料があることを確認した。また、違法な燃料が入っているとみられる複数のコンテナも積載していた」としている。

ただ、当局がどのように燃料がキューバ向けだと把握したか、また同船がどれだけの燃料を積載していたかには言及していない。

トランプ政権はキューバの体制転換を目標としていると公言している。今年に入って発動された米国による石油封鎖を受け、同国は燃料不足や停電など深刻な打撃を受けている。

item.title: Wall Street cierra al alza por datos de empleo que frenan las expectativas de subida de tasas
item.description: Las bolsas estadounidenses subieron el viernes en el cierre de la semana bursátil, después de que unos datos de empleo más débiles de lo esperado en Estados Unidos frenaron las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas de interés este mes.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas estadounidenses subieron el viernes en el cierre de la semana bursátil, después de que unos datos de empleo más débiles de lo esperado en Estados Unidos frenaron las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas de interés este mes. Las nóminas no agrícolas sumaron 29.000 puestos de trabajo el mes pasado y las cifras de los dos meses anteriores se revisaron drásticamente a la baja, mostró el viernes el muy esperado reporte de empleo del Departamento de Trabajo. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters habían pronosticado un aumento de 90.000. Los datos, peores de lo previsto, redujeron las expectativas de que la Fed suba las tasas de interés al menos 25 puntos básicos en su reunión de finales de octubre al 22,7%, según el CME FedWatch, desde el 24,4% de la sesión anterior y el 64,2% de la semana anterior. "Las noticias de hoy han estado bien, en la medida en que indican que la economía no está en pleno auge", dijo Robert Bernstone, director de operaciones de SummitTX Capital. "Pero, ¿hasta qué punto es eso positivo? Sí, está bien en la medida en que descarta una subida de tasas a corto plazo, pero existe preocupación por la economía y por la inflación, por lo que la gente se mantiene en una especie de optimismo cauteloso". Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 57,93 puntos, o un 0,76%, a 7.724,38 puntos, mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 319,73 puntos, o un 1,19%, a 27.191,33. El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) subió 260,15 puntos, o un 0,51%, a 51.186,71. Las expectativas moderadas respecto a una inminente subida de tasas contribuyeron a impulsar a las acciones sensibles a las tasas de interés, como el índice inmobiliario del S&P 500 (.SPLRCR) y el índice de pequeña capitalización Russell 2000 (.RUT) , que ganaron alrededor de un 1% y registraron su mayor subida diaria en un mes. Las acciones de gran capitalización contribuyeron a liderar el avance, con Nvidia (NVDA.O) y Tesla (TSLA.O) entre las que más impulsaron al S&P 500.

item.title: Monedas suben tras dato de empleo en EEUU que reduce aún más expectativas alza tasas Fed
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el viernes, en medio de un ligero retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales tras un nuevo dato del empleo en Estados Unidos que cementó las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal no subirá las tasas de interés en octubre.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el viernes, en medio de un ligero retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales tras un nuevo dato del empleo en Estados Unidos que cementó las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal no subirá las tasas de interés en octubre. * [USN:L6N45O0QK TEXT:"El crecimiento del empleo"] en Estados Unidos se ralentizó más de lo esperado en septiembre, pero es probable que esto no suponga un cambio significativo en el mercado laboral, ya que esta debilidad podría deberse a una circunstancia puntual relacionada con el calendario. * El empleo no agrícola aumentó en 29.000 puestos de trabajo el mes pasado, tras un incremento revisado a la baja de 133.000 en agosto, reveló el viernes el informe de empleo del Departamento de Trabajo. * Tras la publicación de los datos del viernes, los contratos de futuros sobre tasas de interés reflejaban una probabilidad inferior a una entre cinco de que se produjera un aumento de tasas en la reunión de octubre de la Fed, frente a la probabilidad superior a una entre cuatro que se estimaba anteriormente. * Los operadores ya habían recortado el miércoles las expectativas de un alza de tasas, luego que un dato mostró que la inflación se aceleró menos de lo esperado en agosto, aunque los mercados siguen apostando a un incremento en diciembre, con una probabilidad cercana al 90%. * Tras el dato, el índice dólar , que compara a la divisa estadounidense frente a una canasta de seis importantes monedas, retrocedía alrededor de un 0,1%. * Además, en la sesión los futuros del crudo Brent subieron mientras que los del West Texas Intermediate (WTI) redujeron parte de sus pérdidas el viernes, después de que los líderes europeos accedieron a la petición del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de liberar reservas de diésel para bajar los precios. * El peso mexicano cotizaba cerca del cierre en 18,1480 por dólar, con una ganancia del 0,71% tras cuatro sesiones consecutivas de pérdidas. * En la semana, la moneda acumulaba una depreciación del 2,8%, como parte de en un rápido deterioro que ha sorprendido a inversionistas en las últimas semanas. A inicios de septiembre, el peso se negociaba por debajo de las 17 unidades por dólar, en niveles no vistos en más de dos años. * "La apreciación del peso... ocurre a la par de un retroceso del dólar... de acuerdo con el índice ponderado, luego de que en Estados Unidos el reporte de empleo de septiembre mostró señales de debilidad en el mercado laboral, permitiendo al mercado especular que la Reserva Federal podría ser más cautelosa para seguir subiendo la tasa de interés", dijo Banco Base en un reporte. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, subía cerca del cierre un 1,14%, a 64.555,67 unidades. * El real brasileño , se apreció un 0,13%, a 5,2173 unidades por dólar, con un descenso semanal del 0,65%, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo escaló un 2,46%, a 191.797,94 puntos, según el cierre preliminar. * Los mercados brasileños ajustaron posiciones antes de la la primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales del domingo en la mayor economía de América Latina, aunque se espera que ningún candidato logre el triunfo. * El presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva aventaja al senador Flávio Bolsonaro, su principal rival, en una posible segunda vuelta de cara a las elecciones de este mes, reveló el jueves por la noche una encuesta de Datafolha. * Mientras, la producción industrial de Brasil cayó de forma inesperada en agosto, revelaron el viernes los datos de la agencia de estadística IBGE, lo que se suma a los indicios de que los elevados costos de financiación están lastrando la actividad económica. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista ganó un 0,23% a 1.521,5 por dólar, con regulación del banco central (BCRA) mediante la compra diaria de divisas para reforzar sus reservas internacionales. El organismo sumó 35 millones de dólares este viernes y terminó la semana con un saldo favorable de 369 millones en su intervención. * En la bolsa de Buenos Aires, el referencial accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) subió un 0,32% al cierre. * El peso chileno , , sin e,bargo, cotizó a contramano de sus pares de la región y cayó un 0,68%, a 992,20/992,50 unidades por dólar, a su menor valor de cierre desde enero del año pasado y acumuló una baja semanal del 3,12%. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , subió un leve 0,08%, a 10.916,57 puntos. * El peso colombiano se fortaleció un 1,37% a 3.264,50 unidades por dólar y en la semana acumuló una apreciación del 1,43%; en tanto que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) finalizó con caída de un 0,59% a 2.515,02 puntos. * Es necesario pensar en instrumentos diferentes a la tasa de interés para reducir la inflación, dijo el viernes el codirector del Banco Central de Colombia, César Giraldo, sin ofrecer más detalles. * Los comentarios de Giraldo se registran dos días después de que el directorio del Banco Central decidió por mayoría incrementar su tasa de interés de referencia en 25 puntos base a un 12,25%, en busca de contener las presiones inflacionarias, en una decisión que sorprendió a la mayoría del mercado que esperaba que la mantuviera estable. * La moneda peruana, el sol subió un 0,49%, a 3.4320/3.4360 unidades por dólar. Por otra parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) caía un 0,12%, a 1.576,67 puntos.

item.title: Dutch eyewear chain Hans Anders halts sale of Meta glasses, citing privacy concerns
item.description: One of the largest Dutch eyewear retail chains said on Friday it had suspended sales of Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses in the Netherlands and Belgium amid growing privacy concerns, in one of the first such moves by a retailer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: One of the largest Dutch eyewear retail chains said on Friday it had suspended sales of Meta's (META.O) Ray-Ban smart glasses in the Netherlands and Belgium amid growing privacy concerns, in one of the first such moves by a retailer. "This decision follows the ongoing public and political debate surrounding smart glasses and the questions being raised about the conditions under which this technology can be used," a spokesperson for the Hans Anders chain said. A growing Dutch outcry over the glasses mirrors a [USN:L4N45A01A TEXT:"broader backlash"] against smart glasses equipped with cameras. In Britain, pub chain Wetherspoon has restricted use of Meta's glasses over concerns about covert recording, while Meta and Luxottica face a US suit alleging videos captured by the glasses were viewed by human annotators without the knowledge of people filmed. A Meta spokesperson said the company is continuing to develop the popular glasses. "Every pair with a camera has a bright light on the front that blinks when you take a photo or video — it can't be turned off, and the camera is disabled if someone covers or tampers with it," they said. In the Netherlands, privacy regulator AP last month warned that videos made with smart glasses showing identifiable people cannot generally be shared or published without their permission, which would be difficult to obtain in a public place. Consumer rights group Consumentenbond this week said it would take Meta to court unless the company changes the glasses to comply with privacy law. Offlimits, a group that combats online abuse, on Friday also urged Meta and Ray-Ban owner EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) to voluntarily remove the glasses from sale until a way can be found to make surreptitious recordings impossible. EssilorLuxottica could not immediately be reached for comment. Hans Anders is a subsidiary of Nexeye, which is owned by private equity firm KKR (KKR.N) . Nexeye operates 776 stores across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria and Sweden. It does not sell the glasses in the latter three countries.

GENEVA: Three-in-four families in parts of Yemen are going hungry from the "absolutely devastating" impact of a surge in fighting, which has displaced tens of thousands of people and disrupted supplies to millions, the World Food Programme said on Friday (Oct 2). Yemen is experiencing the most serious escalation in fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-aligned Houthi group since a UN-brokered truce largely halted cross-border attacks in 2022. The renewed conflict could reshape control in Yemen, with implications for Red Sea shipping lanes. Within just a few weeks, the fighting has driven the share of households without sufficient food to 74% in government-controlled areas accessible to WFP, the UN hunger body's Assistant Executive Director for Programme Operations told reporters in Geneva. The total population of government-held areas is estimated at around 10 million people. “The effect of this latest flare-up of insecurity on the food security situation threatens to be absolutely devastating,” Hollingworth told reporters in Geneva via video link from Rome.

The Houthis, who already control most of northern Yemen including the capital Sanaa, seized the country's entire Red Sea coast last month from Saudi-backed forces of the internationally recognised government, based in the southern port of Aden. Displaced families are arriving outside Aden and around the mountain city of Taiz without any water or food, as many had to leave everything behind, WFP said.

Related:

Houthis say Saudi strikes on Yemen's Taiz leave dozens of casualties

Saudi coalition accuses Houthis of drone attack on Madinah

Prices of basic food staples such as wheat flour and vegetable oil are rising in a country that imports around 90 per cent of its food. “We are looking at a hunger crisis that is going to grow as it persists,” Hollingworth said, adding that frontline areas like Taiz were increasingly hard to access due to the fighting. WFP said it was scaling up its response but unless it gets around US$109 million in funding within a few weeks it will run out of food stocks and money to help the 152,000 newly displaced persons inside the country, as well as the 1.4 million people it is already supporting. Hollingworth also pointed to the potential ripple effects of disruption to two major chokepoints in the Middle East: the Bab el-Mandeb Strait near Yemen at the mouth of the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz on the opposite side of the Arabian Peninsula. That, as well as disruption in the Black Sea due to the Ukraine-Russia conflict, risk driving up food and fuel prices and deepening food insecurity globally. A new analysis published by UN Women on Friday said an additional 11.7 million women and girls across 28 countries including Yemen, Sudan and Lebanon could face food insecurity by the end of the year, due to escalation in the Middle East and disruption to the Strait of Hormuz.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: Plaza financiera argentina opera con divergencias, salto del riesgo país
item.description: El mercado financiero argentino arrojó el viernes una nueva ronda de marcada selectividad y prudencia, mientras que el riesgo país trepaba a los 655 puntos básicos como nivel preocupante y tope en 10 meses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mercado financiero argentino arrojó el viernes una nueva ronda de marcada selectividad y prudencia, mientras que el riesgo país trepaba a los 655 puntos básicos como nivel preocupante y tope en 10 meses. Las miradas de los inversores posaron también en el impacto del dato de empleo en Estados Unidos y las implicancias políticas regionales con las elecciones presidenciales del domingo en el vecino Brasil. En la bolsa de Buenos Aires, el referencial accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) arrojó una mejora del 0,32% al cierre, al tiempo que los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles promediaron una caída del 0,5% a contramano de la positividad de Wall Street. "El mercado en Estados Unidos reaccionó positivamente a datos peores que los esperados de tasa de desempleo y nóminas de empleados (...) La tasa de desempleo subió a 4,2%, frente al 4,1% esperado. Un mercado laboral más débil le quita fuerza a la expectativa de suba de tasas en la próxima reunión de la FED en octubre", remarcó Quantum Finanzas. Mientras tanto, el riesgo país argentino subía a su máximo desde finales de noviembre pasado, muy lejos de las ansiadas 250 a 300 unidades como para que eventualmente el Gobierno pensara en retornar a los mercados internacionales de crédito ante un pesado panorama de vencimientos en el 2027. "Para la Argentina, el resultado electoral de Brasil no es neutro en el plano político: un nuevo mandato de Lula (da Silva)prolongaría la distancia con la Casa Rosada, mientras que un triunfo de (Flavio) Bolsonaro abriría una etapa de mayor afinidad con el Gobierno de (Javier) Milei", reportó la consultora ABECEB. "Sin embargo, el comercio bilateral se mantiene firme pese al enfriamiento diplomático, porque responde a una lógica productiva, con el intercambio automotriz como columna vertebral, que los vaivenes de la política no alcanzan a alterar", agregó. El peso mayorista ganó un 0,23% a 1.521,5 por dólar , con regulación del banco central (BCRA) mediante la compra diaria de divisas para reforzar sus reservas internacionales. Esta entidad sumó 35 millones de dólares este viernes y terminó la semana con un saldo favorable de 369 millones en su intervención.

item.title: 再送Ｇ７、石油備蓄1億バレル協調放出へ 当初は軽油重点で市場安定化狙う
item.description:
(見出しの脱字を補います。)
[パリ ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
(見出しの脱字を補います。)

[パリ ２日 ロイター] - 主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）を通じてディーゼル燃料（軽油）などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。直ちに開始し、４カ月間にわたって実施する。

Ｇ７議長国のフランス大統領府が公表した声明によると、Ｇ７加盟国とパートナー国は最初の２０日間に大量の軽油を重点的に放出する。マクロン仏大統領は、放出対象は軽油と原油で、規模は最大１億バレルになると説明した。

放出する原油、軽油、その他の製品の内訳は示されていないほか、どの国が参加するのか明記されていない。声明は「今後数日中にＩＥＡの枠組みにおいて会合を開き、必要に応じて軽油の追加放出の可能性について協議する」とした。

Ｇ７の発表に先立ち、トランプ米大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で「欧州は大量に備蓄しているディーゼルを大規模に放出することに合意した。手続きは直ちに開始される」と表明していた。

Ｇ７はまた、加盟各国の製油所の保守点検日程を調整する方針を表明。ＩＥＡに対し、２０２６年３月のコミットメントが直ちにかつ完全に履行されるよう監視することを要請した。

エネルギーおよびエネルギー製品について、Ｇ７諸国間で輸出制限を控えるとの約束を再確認。全ての生産国に対し、市場の緊張を悪化させかねない禁止措置を導入しないよう求めた。

マクロン氏は、ホルムズ海峡を通じたエネルギー供給の確保に向け、引き続き行動を調整することで合意したと述べた。

声明はイランによる近隣諸国への攻撃を改めて非難し、ロシアに対する制裁を維持する方針も示した。

item.title: Chinese auto show debuts in Argentina as sales surge
item.description: Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment.
item.dc:creator: Leila Miller
item.content:encoded: Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment. Chinese brands are flooding the market, benefiting from a measure that allows in up to 50,000 electric and hybrid vehicles without tariffs in 2026. Chinese brands accounted for 10% of car and light commercial vehicle sales in Argentina in August, up from about 2% late last year. Since launching in Argentina [USN:L6N3VO0YF TEXT:"in late 2025"], China's electric vehicle maker BYD (002594.SZ) has become the ninth best-selling car brand. The company leads electric car sales in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Uruguay. At the auto show, more than 20 Chinese brands, including [USN:L4N45E0BT TEXT:"Geely"] (0175.HK) , Chery (9973.HK) , GWM (601633.SS) and [USN:L1N45K00B TEXT:"Dongfeng"], were on display. German Molina, a 3D designer who already owns a Chinese car and wants to buy another, looked around with his wife and son. "If you go out onto the main avenues or neighborhoods, you see a large number of Chinese cars, and it’s not just one brand, but many different ones," said Molina. "I believe it’s only a matter of time before people start embracing them a bit more." Sebastian Beato, president of Argentina’s auto dealers’ association ACARA, said the "impressive" growth among Chinese brands had pushed the national industry to produce new models, such as the [USN:L8N4500PL TEXT:"Renault Niagara"] pick-up truck unveiled in September. Earlier this week the Argentine government said Japanese automaker Toyota Motor (7203.T) would [USN:L6N45M1A7 TEXT:"invest"] $1.34 billion to develop an EV plant in Argentina. If Argentina's auto industry doesn’t transform, "it’s going to have obsolete cars," Beato said. MILEI UNCONCERNED Chinese automakers are steadily expanding across Latin America, selling both traditional vehicles and EVs at a pace that has alarmed some local markets. Brazil and Mexico have introduced tariffs aimed at slowing the influx and protecting domestic manufacturing jobs. But Milei, a libertarian, has said he is unconcerned by the rapid growth of BYD and dismissed suggestions that it could complicate his close relationship with the US during an interview last month. "What Argentines buy is the problem of Argentines," Milei told Bloomberg at the Economic Club of New York. Tesla in July launched operations in Uruguay, and there are signs the US automaker could soon enter Argentina. The registration of Tesla Argentina appeared in the country's official gazette in April, and state energy company YPF said in June it had signed a letter of intent with Tesla to explore [USN:S0N41Q00Y TEXT:"energy storage"] opportunities. Tesla did not respond to a request for comment. 'POSSIBILITY TO COMPETE' Car sales in Argentina have fallen 13% so far this year from the same period in 2025, a decline that industry analysts attribute to a market adjustment after last year's strong growth was fueled by lower trade barriers. High interest rates have also dissuaded consumers from taking out car loans. Andres Civetta, an economist at consultancy Abeceb, said Argentina's auto industry should focus on pick-up trucks, where the country has established a strong export position and doesn't yet face competition from Chinese brands. Fernando Rodriguez Canedo, executive director of Argentina's association of car factories, welcomed Milei's gradual rollback of national export duties and said the industry was also pressing provincial governments to reduce local taxes. "That would give us the possibility to compete," Canedo said.

item.title: Sleepless on Wall Street: All-night stock exchanges coming soon
item.description: US equity exchanges will begin extended trading hours with an overnight session from 9 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting December 6. The changes aim to cater to growing foreign investor interest and compete with crypto markets. However, concerns about market liquidity and increased risks during these hours are prevalent among institutional investors. Pre-existing trading volumes suggest that institutional participation during night hours may be limited.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: For decades, US equity exchanges have hit the pause button every night, leaving markets shut for several hours. Come December, the lights will stay on much longer as the stock market shifts toward around-the-clock trading.Nasdaq, NYSE Arca, 24X National Exchange and Cboe EDGX have crafted plans to add an overnight session from 9 p.m. to 4 a.m. in New York, on top of the regular hours and existing pre- and post-market periods they already operate. The expansion, set to take place on Dec. 6, seeks to capture growing demand from foreign investors while competing with crypto and prediction markets, which have upended traditional expectations of Wall Street’s operating hours.Overnight trading has existed for years, primarily through alternative trading systems, but it’s made up a tiny slice of the total activity — around 1% of equity trading volume in the second quarter, data presented at a Securities and Exchange Commission roundtable last week show. But while tiny next to daytime trading by any account, overnight trading is growing quickly, surging 358% from a year ago.The anticipated implementation of 23/5 trading has sparked a debate about what longer hours would mean for market participants worldwide. Proponents say the expansion will remove time-zone barriers and give foreign traders better access to US markets. Skeptics see lower liquidity and wider bid-ask spreads as amplifying trading risks.Institutional investors are mainly worried “about the market quality during the extended hours,” said David Easthope, a senior analyst at Crisil Coalition Greenwich, while concerns about operations and staffing are not necessarily at the top of their list.A survey of buy-side equity traders the firm conducted last year showed market participants were not eager to trade stocks around the clock. With fewer players active outside regular hours, investors could face lower trading volumes, thinner liquidity and wider bid-ask spreads. That could bring additional operational risk and complexity, or even affect traders’ own physical and mental health, the survey showed.The group’s sentiment has somewhat improved since the survey was conducted in the second part of 2025. There’s now “a greater sense of inevitability,” particularly as regulators move forward with the changes, Easthope said.The concept of overnight trading has been popular with retail investors and trading venues for years. Once the December changes kick in, “the usual suspects will be there and be ready,” said Brian Hyndman, chief executive officer of Blue Ocean Technologies, one of the ATS providers that currently facilitate overnight trading.“But I still think that we’re missing part of the industry, and that’s really the buy side and the investment banks,” he added. “They’ve been hesitant to get involved.”Key market infrastructure providers are also preparing for the shift. Depository Trust & Clearing Corp., the main firm responsible for clearing US stock trades, in June moved to a 24x5 model running from 8 p.m. New York time on Sunday to 8 p.m. New York time on Friday. Securities Information Processors, or SIPs, which collect and distribute quotes and trade data, also got a regulatory nod to extend their operating hours to support overnight trading.Proponents of the shift are likely betting on the idea that once the infrastructure is there, institutional demand will follow suit, said Joseph Saluzzi, partner and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading LLC.Yet he’s skeptical about the transition.“Institutional investors have no interest in trading in a low liquidity, wide-spread market which is likely to be very volatile,” he said, adding that the combined volume of pre- and post-market trading on the exchanges accounts for just about 10% of the overall trading activity. “There’s actually a case, if you wanted to make it, that we have too many hours in the market, not too few.”For now, institutional investors remain in wait and see mode. If the Dec. 6 shift improves price discovery during late hours, the cost of trading will eventually drop, helping institutional money managers capture alpha during the night, according to Jeff O’Connor, Liquidnet’s head of market structure.Naturally, foreign investors are particularly active in late hours. They accounted for 37% of overnight trading volume in the second quarter, compared with just 7% for institutional accounts, according to the SEC data.That trading activity is also highly concentrated. In August, just 15 stocks on average were responsible for half of the total overnight volume, often including sub-dollar shares of companies domiciled in China and Hong Kong. By contrast, 256 stocks accounting for half the volume during the regular session.For now, Nasdaq and NYSE operate core sessions from 9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. ET, five days a week. Those hours are supplemented by before- and after-hours sessions allowing limited types of trading starting as early as 4 a.m. and a post-market session from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. After the December expansion, the exchanges will still have a one-hour break from 8 p.m. to 9 p.m. for maintenance and trade processing.

item.title: 米韓、84億ドルの石油事業巡り食い違い トランプ氏「通商合意の一環」
item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、韓国との通商合意に８４億ドル規模の石油増進回収（ＥＯＲ）プロジェクトが含まれると明らかにした。ただ、
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、韓国との通商合意に８４億ドル規模の石油増進回収（ＥＯＲ）プロジェクトが含まれると明らかにした。ただ、 韓国の聨合ニュースは産業通商資源省高官の話として、同プロジェクトは両国間の戦略的投資協定の一環ではないと報じた。

トランプ大統領は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「韓国との合意は一段と改善している！石油増進回収プロジェクトに８４億ドルが投じられる。石油・ガスの増産は、米国のエネルギー覇権と将来に向けた世界のエネルギー安全保障につながる！」と投稿した。

聨合ニュースの報道によると、韓国政府の当局者は米国側に問い合わせを行ったという。

トランプ氏は９月３０日、韓国が米国内の事業に約２０００億ドルを投資すると発表。ただ、韓国政府はその後、計画の柱の一つとされたアラスカ州の液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）事業向け５４０億ドル規模のパイプライン建設について、現時点で確定したものではないとの認識を示していた。

Oct 2 : Spain forward Ferran Torres has withdrawn from the national squad with an ankle issue and will be replaced by Carlos Espi for the upcoming Nations League matches, the Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) said on Friday. Torres, who plays for Paris St Germain, has been troubled by minor discomfort in his left ankle and, despite training in recent days, was released from the squad to prioritise his recovery, the RFEF said. Coach Luis de la Fuente called up Espi in his place, rewarding the Real Madrid youngster after he scored five goals and set up two more in Spain Under-21s' 13-0 rout of San Marino on Thursday. "Due to the persistence of the symptoms, the decision was made to withdraw him from the squad to prioritise his recovery," the federation said in a statement, adding its medical staff had remained in constant contact with PSG throughout the camp. Spain host the Czech Republic in Oviedo on Saturday before travelling to face Croatia on October 6.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米製造業新規受注、8月は0.1％の小幅増 民間航空機が重し
item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した８月の製造業新規受注は前月比０．１％増の小幅な伸びにとどまっ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米製造業新規受注、8月は0.1％の小幅増　民間航空機が重し 10/2 23:45 配信

米ワシントン州エベレットにある航空機大手ボーイングの工場。７月撮影。Jennifer Buchanan/Seattle Times

[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した８月の製造業新規受注は前月比０．１％増の小幅な伸びにとどまった。電気機器・家電製品・同部品への強い需要があったものの、低調な民間航空機の受注に相殺された。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．１％増だった。

７月は０．９％増から０．８％増に下方改定された。

８月は前年同月比では６．８％増加した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラの拡充に加え、堅調な国内需要に対応するため企業が在庫を再構築していることが製造業の下支えとなっている。ただ、米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争がサプライチェーン（供給網）を混乱させ、エネルギー価格を押し上げている中で、ＡＩ投資ブームと関連性の薄い分野は今後数カ月間、苦戦を強いられる可能性があるとの懸念もある。

８月は、民間航空機・同部品の受注が４．３％減少したことが重しとなった。自動車車体・同部品・トレーラーの受注は０．８％増。機械受注は１．１％増加した。コンピューター・電子製品の受注は横ばいだった一方、前年同月比では１４．７％増加した。電気機器・家電製品・同部品の受注は１．１％急増した。

企業の設備投資計画の指標とされる航空機を除く非国防資本財（コア資本財）の受注は１．６％増と、先月発表の速報値から変わらずだった。コア資本財の出荷は０．５％増と、当初発表の０．６％増から下方改定された。

item.title: 新会社名は「スカイダンス」、パラマウントのＷＢＤ買収完了後＝ＣＥＯ
item.description: [２日 ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンスのデービッド・エリソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
新会社名は「スカイダンス」、パラマウントのＷＢＤ買収完了後＝ＣＥＯ 10/2 23:40 配信

2025年12月8日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[２日 ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンスのデービッド・エリソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２日、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー（ＷＢＤ）買収が来週にも完了次第、統合後の新会社名を「スカイダンス」とすると明らかにした。

エリソン氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で、パラマウントとワーナー・ブラザースの両映画スタジオの個別のアイデンティティーが失われないようにすることが目的で、新たな企業ブランドの下に統合するものではないと説明した。

その上で、「統合後の会社に独自のアイデンティティーを与えつつ、パラマウントとワーナー・ブラザースをはじめとする優れたブランドが引き続きスポットライトを浴び続けられる名称を望んでいた」と述べた。

item.description: Oct 2 : Football Leaks whistleblower Rui Pinto is set to lose his witness protection status in Portugal, his legal team said on Friday, days after an independent commission found Manchester City guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.Pinto, whose disclosures helped trigger scrutiny
item.dc:creator: CNA

Man City whistleblower to lose witness protection days after club's guilty verdict

FILE PHOTO: Football Leaks whistleblower Rui Pinto talks to journalists at the Metropolitan Court in Budapest, Hungary, March 5, 2019. Picture taken March 5, 2019. Hatlaczki Balazs/Handout via REUTERS /File Photo

FAST

Oct 2 : Football Leaks whistleblower Rui Pinto is set to lose his witness protection status in Portugal, his legal team said on Friday, days after an independent commission found Manchester City guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules. Pinto, whose disclosures helped trigger scrutiny of Manchester City's finances, entered Portugal's witness protection programme in 2020 after agreeing to cooperate with authorities and provide files obtained through the Football Leaks operation. City were found guilty of all charges relating to breaches of Premier League financial regulations over nine seasons from 2009-10 to 2017-18, as well as three of four charges concerning failures to cooperate with the investigation. The league said this week that City had used "sham" commercial contracts to inflate revenue and understate costs by more than 900 million pounds ($1.19 billion) over nearly a decade, resulting in inaccurate financial reporting and breaches of spending rules.

The club have denied wrongdoing and appealed the verdict. "In a few days, without being heard beforehand, as required by law, he would lose the protected, confidential residence assigned to him and be forced to find new housing urgently, with no guarantee that police protection will continue," Pinto's legal team said in a statement posted on his X account. "His situation is now critical. The threats against him are not merely theoretical; he was assaulted in Lisbon last April." FOOTBALL LEAKS Launched in 2015, Football Leaks published millions of confidential documents from the football industry, including transfer agreements, contracts and other deals involving clubs, players and agents. Football Leaks' data seen by Reuters showed how some of the richest and most prominent figures in soccer avoided tax by channelling earnings offshore. Pinto was arrested in Hungary in 2019 before being extradited to Portugal, where he later cooperated with authorities and was placed under witness protection. His lawyers said the programme would end on October 10 and argued the decision leaves him at heightened risk, noting legal proceedings stemming from the leaks remained ongoing, including the recent Manchester City case. "If abruptly deprived of his protected housing and plunged into a state of extreme precariousness, Rui Pinto would be more vulnerable now than at any time since 2020," the statement said. Portugal's Justice Ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Friday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 欧州がディーゼル備蓄放出で合意、トランプ氏 価格抑制へ米が圧力
item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、イラン戦争を背景とした燃料価格の高騰を抑制するよう求める米国の圧力を受け、欧州がディーゼル（軽油）燃料の備蓄を放出することで合意したと明らかにした。

トランプ大統領は「欧州は大量に備蓄しているディーゼルを大規模に放出することに合意した。手続きは直ちに開始される」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に投稿した。

関係筋の１人がロイターに語ったところによると、米国はフランスやドイツを含む欧州の主要国に対し、２０日以内に１億バレルのディーゼルを放出するよう要求した。

フランスのエリゼ宮（大統領府）によると、マクロン仏大統領は１日夜、トランプ大統領と電話会談を行い、燃料価格の高騰に対処し、精製石油製品の世界的な供給を確保するために協力する必要性を強調した。こうした中、ＥＵ加盟国は２日、欧州諸国が５０００万バレルのディーゼルを、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）加盟国が５０００万バレルの原油を放出するという仏の提案について協議したと関係筋は話している。

マクロン仏大統領はその後、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）首脳とのビデオ会議を開催し、エネルギー情勢について協議した。

item.title: Israeli officials to question co-pilot of flydubai flight, source says
item.description: Israeli officials are expected to question the co-pilot who allegedly attempted to crash a commercial passenger flight from Dubai bound for Tel Aviv, according to a source briefed on the investigation.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: Israeli officials are expected to question the co-pilot who allegedly attempted to crash a commercial [USN:L6N45N0GW TEXT:"passenger flight"] from Dubai bound for Tel Aviv, according to a source briefed on the investigation. Disaster was averted on [USN:L4N45N0NH TEXT:"flydubai"] flight FZ1073 on Wednesday after passengers and crew subdued the co-pilot, who had [USN:L1N45M07P TEXT:"stabbed"] the captain in what Israeli officials have said was an apparent attempt to crash the plane carrying over 170 passengers and crew. A reserve flydubai pilot crew travelling on the flight landed the plane at Tabuk airport in northwestern Saudi Arabia, where the co-pilot was detained by Saudi Arabian authorities. The co-pilot was transferred on Thursday to the UAE, where the source said Israeli officials were expected to question him. The source declined to say which Israeli agency or authority would take part in the questioning. Asked whether Israeli officials would question the co-pilot, an Israeli government official told Reuters that Israeli investigators would take part in the UAE-led investigation alongside Emirati authorities, seeking to determine what happened and examine the suspect's motives and background. The UAE foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether Israeli officials would question the co-pilot. In his first public comments on the incident, flydubai Chief Executive Ghaith Al Ghaith said on Friday that authorities were conducting an official investigation, supported by the airline, after what he described as a "safety incident" in the cockpit. "It is important that we allow this process to establish the facts," he said in a written statement, acknowledging that there were "many questions" about what happened on flight FZ1073. The UAE state news agency reported on Thursday that Emirati authorities had opened an investigation seeking to establish the circumstances and motives and determine "whether the incident was linked to any terrorist activity or purpose, or involved prior planning or direction". MOTIVE NOT YET ESTABLISHED Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Friday that Israel was looking into whether the co-pilot had acted under anyone's direction, warning in a video statement released by his office that whoever was involved would pay a "heavy price". Most of the passengers on board were Israeli nationals. Netanyahu on Thursday said that the co-pilot, whom he has identified as an Omani national, had undergone radical Islamist indoctrination and was clearly suicidal, but that so far a motive for his actions had not been established. Israel does not have official diplomatic relations with Oman, and Netanyahu has said pilots from such countries were not permitted to operate flights to Israel. It was not clear how the co-pilot came to be assigned to the flight to Tel Aviv. The aircraft plunged some 16,625 feet in just over 30 seconds as it flew over Saudi Arabia on the journey from the United Arab Emirates to Israel, according to data from flight tracker Flightradar24. The route is popular among Israelis. CAPTAIN HAILED AS HERO The co-pilot's identity has not been publicly disclosed beyond his nationality. The captain who was stabbed has been identified as Indian national [USN:L4N45M1MF TEXT:"Smit Machchhar"], who has been [USN:L1N45N01H TEXT:"hailed"] as a hero by Netanyahu and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Omani authorities have not commented on the incident. The incident heightened security fears in Israel weeks before Israelis vote on October 27, in the first general election since the Hamas-led attacks on October 7, 2023, with Israel's security featuring prominently in the campaigning. The US and Israel launched strikes against Iran in February, in a war that quickly spread to the Gulf and Lebanon, where Israel has been fighting Iran-backed militant group Hezbollah. Since coming under attack by Iran this year, the UAE has strengthened its relationships with Israel, with which it opened ties as a result of the 2020 Abraham Accords.

item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が、クレイトン国家情報長官を人工知能（ＡＩ）担当責任者「ＡＩツ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トランプ氏、ＡＩ責任者にクレイトン国家情報長官起用か＝報道 10/2 23:19 配信

[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が、クレイトン国家情報長官を人工知能（ＡＩ）担当責任者「ＡＩツァー（czar）」に指名する見通しであることが分かった。ＣＮＮが２日、関係筋の話として報じた。

item.title: US job growth slows sharply in September; unemployment rate rises to 4.2%
item.description: WASHINGTON: US job growth slowed more than expected in September and the nonfarm payrolls count for the prior two months was revised sharply lower, almost taking another interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve this month off the table.The Labor Department's closely watched employment report on Friday (Oct
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

US job growth slows sharply in September; unemployment rate rises to 4.2%

A job seeker waits to talk to a recruiter at a job fair on Aug 28, 2025, in Sunrise, Florida. (Photo: AP/Marta Lavandier)

FAST

WASHINGTON: US job growth slowed more than expected in September and the nonfarm payrolls count for the prior two months was revised sharply lower, almost taking another interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve this month off the table. The Labor Department's closely watched employment report on Friday (Oct 2) also showed the unemployment rate increased to 4.2 per cent last month from 4.1 per cent in August as more people entered the workforce. The sharp moderation in job growth likely does not mark a sudden deterioration in labour market conditions. Economists noted that payrolls have a tendency to underperform when the Labor Day holiday falls relatively late in September, as was the case this year. There have been no signs of a broad increase in layoffs. First-time applications for unemployment benefits have been hovering at 57-year lows amid robust corporate profit growth and resilient domestic demand. Economists said the report reaffirmed the labour market's "low-hire, low-fire" state and likely had no impact on near-term monetary policy, with inflation remaining the key focus.

"This is a disappointing jobs report and a reminder that the low-hire, low-fire labour market never went away," said Olu Sonola, head of US economics at Fitch Ratings. "Weak job growth, a slightly higher unemployment rate, contained wage gains and downward revisions to earlier payroll estimates give the Fed little reason to keep an October rate hike on the table. But CPI remains the report that matters most." Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 jobs last month after a downwardly revised rise of 133,000 in August, the Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics said. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast payrolls would advance by 90,000 after a previously reported surge of 162,000 in August. Estimates ranged from as low as 35,000 to as high as 180,000. The data for July was revised to show the economy shed 10,000 jobs, the second time this year that payrolls turned negative. All told, the economy added 60,000 fewer jobs in July and August than previously estimated. Volatility linked to the model the government uses to strip out seasonal fluctuations from the data likely accounted for both the meagre payroll gains last month and the downward revision to the count for August. Economists, however, said they expected growing headwinds from the US-Israel war with Iran, including high energy prices and strained supply chains, would start disrupting the labour market by the end of this year and into 2027. Diesel prices are at record highs and could start to exert pressure beyond the transportation and agricultural sectors. Ongoing tariffs also are a source of concern, with an Institute for Supply Management survey on Thursday showing rising anxiety among manufacturers over the trade war with Canada. HEALTHCARE PAYROLLS RISE MARGINALLY Healthcare continued to account for the bulk of the job growth, adding 17,000 positions, a figure that was well below the average monthly gain of 33,000 in the past 12 months. Those job gains occurred in ambulatory healthcare services and at hospitals. Employment in nursing and residential care facilities dropped by 9,000 positions, which could be related to the termination of Temporary Protected Status for hundreds of thousands of Haitian immigrants. Construction payrolls increased by 11,000, while manufacturers added 9,000. Financial activities employment dropped by 7,000 positions. Despite job growth almost stalling last month, the average workweek was unchanged at 34.4 hours. Financial markets further reduced bets on a rate hike at the US central bank's Oct 27-28 meeting to roughly 13 per cent, down from 22 per cent prior to the report and about 69 per cent a week ago, CME Group's FedWatch tool showed. The odds of further monetary policy tightening had already been diminished by cooler-than-expected inflation readings for August and July. The Fed last month raised its benchmark overnight interest rate by 25 basis points to the 3.75-4.00 per cent range, the first hike in three years, and flagged further increases in borrowing costs ahead. With inflation still above the central bank's 2 per cent target, economists continued to expect a rate hike in December. US stocks opened higher. The dollar slipped against a basket of currencies. US Treasury yields were mostly lower. The rise in the unemployment rate reflected a jump of 485,000 in the labour force. This lifted the labour force participation rate to 61.8 per cent last month from 61.6 per cent in August. Household employment increased by 406,000.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: Retornos bonos Tesoro EEUU suben, revierten reacción inicial tras débil dato empleo
item.description: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos revirtieron sus caídas iniciales el viernes, a medida que los inversores asimilaban un informe de empleo de septiembre más débil de lo previsto y que moderó las apuestas sobre subidas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew
item.content:encoded: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos revirtieron sus caídas iniciales el viernes, a medida que los inversores asimilaban un informe de empleo de septiembre más débil de lo previsto y que moderó las apuestas sobre subidas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal. * La economía estadounidense creó 29.000 puestos de trabajo en septiembre, frente a los 90.000 previstos, según el informe del Departamento de Trabajo, que también situó la tasa de desempleo de septiembre en el 4,2%, por encima del 4,1% previsto por los economistas. El crecimiento del empleo en agosto se revisó a la baja, pasando de los 162.000 puestos comunicados previamente a 133.000. * Aunque inicialmente los inversores reaccionaron al informe comprando bonos del Tesoro de forma generalizada, posteriormente se reanudaron las ventas, lo que puso de manifiesto las numerosas fuentes de tensión que pesan actualmente sobre este mercado: desde un crecimiento económico sólido y una elevada emisión de deuda hasta los temores inflacionarios. * Los operadores descontaban una probabilidad de alrededor del 80% de que las tasas de interés se mantengan sin cambios en la reunión de este mes, frente al 74% previo a los datos. Las expectativas de un alza en diciembre oscilaron en torno al 86%, según datos de LSEG. * Sobre la reversión de los retornos tras la reacción inicial, Molly Brooks, estratega de tasas de interés en Estados Unidos para TD Securities, apuntó a las fluctuaciones en las expectativas sobre la política monetaria de la Fed durante la sesión, así como a la toma de ganancias y al reposicionamiento de carteras de cara al fin de semana. * En el conjunto de la semana, la rentabilidad a dos años cayó 3,3 puntos básicos, en su primer descenso semanal desde la segunda semana de agosto. El rendimiento de referencia a 10 años anotó a una subida semanal de 10 puntos básicos, su quinto avance semanal consecutivo. El retorno a 30 años acumuló un incremento semanal de 13,2 puntos básicos, el segundo ascenso seguido. * Tras los descensos previos, el rendimiento a 10 años subió 4,72 puntos básicos (pb), al 5,281%; el de las notas a 30 años sumó 2,91 pb, al 5,6321%; y el de la deuda a dos años , que suele moverse en línea con las expectativas sobre tasas de la Fed, avanzó 3,98 pb, al 4,827%. * Un segmento muy seguido de la curva, que mide la diferencia entre las tasas a dos y 10 años y es considerado un indicador de las expectativas económicas, se situó en 45,2 puntos básicos.

item.title: テスラの世界納車、第3四半期は市場予想上回る 欧州で需要回復
item.description:
Anhata Rooprai Akash Sriram
[２日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２日発...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
テスラの世界納車、第3四半期は市場予想上回る　欧州で需要回復 10/2 23:16 配信

フランス・パリ近郊にあるテスラの納車センター。2025年4月撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

Anhata Rooprai　Akash Sriram

[２日　ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２日発表した第３・四半期（７─９月期）の世界納車台数は４８万６５３２台と、市場予想を上回った。欧州での需要回復が、米国での税制優遇措置の失効や中国での競争激化による影響を相殺した。

同社の株価は午前の取引で約４％超上昇した。

ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想平均は４５万６８９６台だった。今年初めとは異なり、アナリストらは納車台数の通年予想を引き上げている。２０２６年の納車台数は１８２万台と、６月時点のコンセンサス予想の１６５万台から上方修正した。

ただ、納車台数が３年連続で前年比減となる事態を回避するには、同社は第４・四半期に少なくとも３１万１４４８台を納車する必要がある。

欧州では昨年、イーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の政治的言動への反発などから販売が低迷したものの、欧州連合（ＥＵ）での新車登録台数は８月までで約３分の２増加。フランスでは「モデルＹ」が全車種を通じて最も売れた車となった。

モーニングスターのアナリスト、セス・ゴールドスタイン氏は「この堅調な数字により、テスラは２年連続の減少を経て、通年の納車台数が増加に転じる軌道に乗った。ＦＳＤ（完全自動運転）が、消費者が他の自動車メーカーではなくテスラを選ぶ決め手となっている」と述べた。

テスラの第３・四半期の車両生産台数は４６万４３９１台で、予想の４８万６７６１台を下回った。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：減速するテスラ、頼みの綱は国内ライバル勢の出遅れ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 アングル：ロボタクシー拡大に慎重になったテスラ　投資家の不満解消できるか アングル：テスラのロボタクシー、導入済みテキサス3都市では課題山積 アングル：テスラの納車台数、26年予想下振れ　3年連続減少の見方も 最終更新: 10/2(金) 23:16 ロイター

item.description: RIJEKA, Croatia, Oct 2 : Manchester City's guilty verdict for serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules has become a major topic of discussion in the England camp, manager Thomas Tuchel said before Saturday's Nations League match against Croatia.City were found guilty by an independent commissi
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Man City verdict a big topic in England camp, Tuchel says

Soccer Football - UEFA Nations League - England Press Conference - Stadion HNK Rijeka, Rijeka, Croatia - October 2, 2026 England manager Thomas Tuchel during the press conference REUTERS/Antonio Bronic

02 Oct 2026 09:57PM

FAST

RIJEKA, Croatia, Oct 2 : Manchester City's guilty verdict for serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules has become a major topic of discussion in the England camp, manager Thomas Tuchel said before Saturday's Nations League match against Croatia. City were found guilty by an independent commission of all charges relating to financial rule breaches over nine seasons from 2009-10 to 2017-18, as well as three of four charges concerning failures to cooperate with the investigation. The club, who have denied wrongdoing throughout the process, appealed against the commission's ruling on Friday as they seek to overturn the verdict and avoid potentially severe sanctions. Midfielder Elliot Anderson and centre back Marc Guehi are among the City players in the England squad, while left back Nico O'Reilly returned to the club because of injury.

Asked whether the verdict was being discussed by the players and whether he had spoken to City's contingent, Tuchel told reporters on Friday: "I guess so. We had some time off between the matches and it is a big subject. "Everyone speaks about it, so there is no other voice needed. I am glad to be not that voice. No one needs my half knowledge on the topic. "Of course, the players talk about it. City players talk about it. We talk with them but only briefly. They are ready to go tomorrow. But of course, it's a big topic in the camp." Tuchel was also asked whether he would continue selecting City players if the club were relegated from the Premier League. "There is always a possibility," the German said. "I would always try to pick the best team for the camp, occasion, the tournament. I will never rule out that because they don't play in the top flight in their country. "We need to look at it case by case." England are second in Group A3 with three points from two matches, having lost 3-2 to Spain at Wembley before beating the Czech Republic 2-0 in Prague on Tuesday. They face Croatia in the port city of Rijeka, where the match will be played behind closed doors following crowd disturbances involving Croatia supporters during a Nations League quarter-final against France in March 2025. "It has made a huge difference for us to have three days in between so that we could take care of players with high output like Anderson and Gordon, for example," Tuchel said. "Everyone has been at training today except for O'Reilly, who had to leave camp to get treatment and leave as soon as possible. His discomfort was too painful and he couldn't be on the pitch. "Everyone else started and ended training today on a high level."

Source: Reuters
